tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi dga' ston drug pa btang ba dang bstun rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug khrir 'don byas skabs kyi deb bsgrigs ngo mtshar smon gnas sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// shrī wan bhu mi paṇḍu ka saṅgu ru ye na maḥ dngos grub rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /skyabs gnas bslu med rin chen dkon mchog gsum/ /grub gnyis stsol ba'i yi dam chos skyong dang / /nor lhar bcas pas don gnyis lhun grub stsol/ /khyad par bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched la/ /snying nas 'dud do bdag cag brgyud par bcas/ /skyes mchog khyed dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ 'dir sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi rigs dang chos las skyes pa'i bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug sogs sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams che 'don byed du gtong dgos sogs lag tu len rgyu deb tu bkod pa la/ ༈ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid rgyal ba'i sras rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul bar ma chad pa byon nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'di nyid du/ dkar po dge ba'i las kyi 'brel pa ji snyed cig gi sa bon btab ste longs spyod don yod pa bya dgos pa yin pas/ de la don gnyis te/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur la che bar 'don pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po sgrub pa/ bla ma slob dpon/ sde dpon rigs sogs kyi sku rim bsgrub pa dang / gnyis pa bla ma gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs/ sde dpon rigs kyi shin po'i don du 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyis sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po sgrub pa'o/

/dang po ni/ nged rang gi zhal ngo che 'don mdzad cing khri khar 'khod nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba da lo'i gnas skabs su phyir gtong dgos/ nang du khri ston gyi 'bul ba rnam gzhag byung tshul sgrig bca' ltar gyi bkod pa che phra byas tshul brjod na/ lo dus kyi dus mdos chen mo brgyangs nas rgyal zla ba'i nyer drug la chos skyong spyan 'dren shin tu zab pa'i ngos/ gdan drangs nas cho ga tshugs pa mdzad/ nyer bdun la 'cham res dkyus ma gang rgyas/ nyer brgyad la nged rang dpon slob tshang mas gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po sngags 'chang kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi gzigs snang bzhin ru 'dren sde bzhi'i 'cham rgyas pa/ nyer dgu la phyir mdos rgyag de thog nged rang gi mnga' zhabs stod smad thams cad kyi rgyab dmag zab bshoms byas/ shab pa'i rgan pa rnams la mnga' gsol gyi tshogs 'khor steng lto chang ja sogs 'os bab ster/ nyer drug gi snga dro shab pa'i skyes 'cham pa rnams la ja chang lto gnyis spel yod pa ster/ gnam gang la chos srung rnams kyi bskang ba brgya rtsa/ tshes gcig la gtang rag gi mnga' gsol/ gnyis dang gsum la lo gsar rgyas pa mdzad/ 'di rnams ni che 'don gyi dus ma byung na yang 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang phyogs nas skye bo ma lus pa 'du ba'i ched dang / gdan sa chen po'i zhabs 'degs/ khyad par sde dpon rigs che phra kun gyi khri ston zhu mi rnams de thog 'byor pa'i bca' bsgrigs pas/ de rnams la mig gang gi ltad mo/ kha gang gi zas zhes pa 'jig rten lugs dang mthun zhing / chos dang mi 'gal ba yin/ de nas bco lnga'i bar mgron po rnams la gzhi len skabs thob dang bstun nas byed/ mar khang du mar khal nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga bton pa'i steng nas mar khal nyi shu rtsa gnyis dkar me la zhu zhing / mar gtub bzhugs gral la phyur phye bre bcu drug mar dang bcas pa/ skya ser yongs la mar rgyar nyag gsum cha ma gtub pa'i mar rgyar khri tsho gnyis dang stong phrag gcig gtub/

mar gtub pa rnams la zhogs rting ma nas dgong ja'i bar tshang ma drangs/ chang nyis mgo gcig dang rkyang mgo gcig song / tshes bcu'i nyin tshogs chen mo'i shar sgo nub sgo gnyis su nas khal stong ra chen re bton pa la lcang ma mgo phod dang bcas pa'i ras chog che ba re btsugs/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin mar gtub bzhugs gral btang ba la/ nang zan min pa'i gral pa nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam la ja spo re phyed do mtho ba bsnon/ bsod nams rdo rje/ byams pa dpal 'byor/ bsod nams rab brtan gsum la thud kha gras gsum re/ mar nyag re/ shar chen pa dang / 'tsho byed rin chen chos 'phel la thud kha gras phyed dang gsum re/ mar nyag re/ ma chen kun bzod/ mchod dpon smon lam rin chen/ mgron gnyer rnams la thud kha gras gnyis re/ mar nyag phyed re/ gnyer khang pa/ 'dren pa/ ja ma/ chibs dpon/ rtsa gnyer gnyis/ shing gnyer ba/ mi dpon rnams dang / skya ho du yod la thud kha gras phyed dang gnyis re/ mar gsum cha re/ mol la ba brgya dpon dge 'dun rin chen la thud zhogs bzhi/ mar nyag bzhi/ mdzod chen la thud kha gras bzhi mar nyag brgyad/ mdzod g.yog gnam sgo ba/ sa sgo ba/ sde pa spyi pa'i bang chen rnams la thud kha gras re/ mar gsum cha re/ bcu dpon gsum la thud kha gras phyed dang gsum re/ mar nyag re/ dkar po rgyang grags pa la thud kha gras gnyis mar nyag phyed/ chos khrims gnyis/ sa skya dpon yig don chen ko lcag pa/ bon gong pa/ dge 'dun dpal 'byor/ 'tsho byed bsam chen/ drung chen byams pa dpal 'byor/ sku mdun rgyal/ drung yig nyi shar ba/ nor bu lha sbyin/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi spyi chos gnyis/ bde chen gling gi spyi pa rnams la thud kha gras gnyis re/ mar nyag phyed re/ stong dpon gsum la thud kha gras re/ mar gsum cha re/ dmag las rnams la thud kha gras phyed dang gnyis re/ mar gsum cha re/ gtso thab dpon la thud kha gras bzhi/ mar khal gcig

gsum gdan snye 'bol/ dkar pang sgog shub/ lcog rtse rnams dang / gsol dpon rang gis btsal nas yong / gtso thab pa'i gsol dpon/ khri gnyer/ gtso thab pa'i g.yog rnams la thud kha gras re/ mar gsum cha re rnams yin/ bzhugs gral la chang nyis mgo gcig rnams dgos/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nyi ma shar gros la tshogs chen mo'i chos khri'i steng nas tshogs dung dkar po rgyang grags btang / chos khrims pa drug dang / drug bcu mthil pa bcu dpon dang bcas pas lus chas zab ma rgyug dmar dang bcas khrims pa rnams kyis sde shar nub tshang ma la skad btang / chos zhu 'dod gang yod da lta tshogs shig pa'i brda sbyar/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho khri chen gyi mdun du bzhugs gral 'grig tshar ba dang / tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug khri khar ma phebs bar yon tan rgya mtsho nyi ma gsum ka la bskul/ skye bo dad pa can ji ltar rigs pa tshogs rjes/ khrims pa rnams kyis bzhi thog tu gdan 'dren la yong mtshams/ dpon slob rnams phebs pa'i sgrigs rim la/ thog mar drug bcu mthil pa'i chos khrims pa rnams dang / chos sde lho byang gi chos khrims las thog pa gnyis kyis gtsos/ rab 'byams pa'i chos khrims pa drug dang / skya bo zhwa lnga rnams bsgrigs/ de rjes rgya gling pa gnyis/ spos sna ba dpal ldan tshe ring / rnam rgyal thog rgod/ dpon yig bkra shis don 'grub rnams gser spen sogs lus chas zab ma rtsi gos dang bcas spos phor gser tshags ma khyad 'phags gsum khyer/ de nas stan dmar dang bzhugs 'ding khur mi mgron gnyer tshe dbang / dngos grub/ sri thar rnams dang / chos nyid rin chen sogs gsol dpon ma chen rnams kyi rjes/ chos zhu ba rnams la maṇḍal gyi nas 'gyed rgyu dngul gyi gzhong pa che ba gsum nas kyis bskangs pa khyer mi ban gtsang pa gzhon pa gsum dang / rgya'i bsil yab khyer mi dge 'dun dpal 'byor/

me tog dam spe khyer mi byams pa dpal 'byor/ mdo bsdud pa khur mkhan dge slong bsam gtan rin chen/ spos glang ring bu dang bcas 'khur mkhan dge slong chos rin chen/ dngul gyi maṇḍal khyad 'phags che ba la maṇḍal so bdun ma'i tshom bu bkod pa mchod dpon dge slong smon lam rin chen gyis khyer/ de mtshams ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sngags pa dkar po'i cha lugs chos gos me long ma paṇa zhwa dang bcas pa'i phyag 'degs pa sku rdzi dge slong bstan pa dar rgyas dang / chos rje kun dga' blo gros gnyis kyis byas pa'i/ chos rjes ber thul gser ma khrom zil gnon khyer/ de rnams kyi rjes su chos sde chen po'i mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa bsam bstan rgya mtsho dang / bsod dbang rang gi gnas kyi slob dpon dbu mdzad dge slong chos 'od zer/ sngon dus nged rang la gus zhen che ba'i rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' bsam 'grub dang / grogs mchog dam pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer gnyis kyi tsha 'o phyag mdzod pa dge slong byams pa dpal 'byor dang / dge slong bsod nams rab brtan gnyis/ gdan sa chen po'i brgya dpon bla ma dge 'dun rin chen/ chos las pa byams pa bkra shis/ ban gtsang dpon gyi dbu mdzad sogs kyis thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams dang / skye bo rtsi gos gyon pa sogs 'khor phun sum tshogs pas bskor te bzhi thog ltag sgo nas phebs/ tshogs kyi shar sgor ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug phebs mtshams/ dge slong kun dga' rnam dpyod kyis dkar po rgyang grags khri chung lho ma'i steng nas 'bud thub pa byed/ 'di bla dung yin pas tshar bcu gsum sha sna bstud nas gtong / de nas rim gyis phebs te tshogs kyi mtha' nas bskor/ khri chung lho ma'i mdun khri chen gyi gdong thad du phebs pa dang /

mgron gnyer gyis stan dmar bting / phyag g.yog pas dbu zhwa bzung nas bzhugs khri la phyag gsum mdzad/ de nas dbu zhwa bzhes te dge 'dun tshogs pa'i nub phyogs bskor te/ khri chen gyi nub sgo nas rim gyis bzhugs gdan steng du phebs/ bsod dbang gi g.yas kyi khri steng du mkhan chen/ mchod dpon sogs dang / g.yon du gnas kyi slob dpon dbu mdzad chos 'od zer phyag mdzod gnyis rnams dang / khri'i rtsa bar phyag 'degs pa gnyis/ brgya dpon/ ban gtsang pa rnams dang / me tog dam spe/ bsil g.yab/ spos phor khyer mi sogs phyag phyi ba rnams bkod pa mdzes pa'i mu nas bzhugs/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sa gdan nyis brtsegs/ 'bol bzhi brtsegs/ gos mtha'/ bzhugs grum/ gos snyel/ bla bre/ grum ze'i steng du gos 'jab thug pa nyis bltabs dang bcas pa/ mkhan chen la sa gdan/ gos 'ja' kha khug brgya dpon la 'bol grum/ gzhan gnas slob chos 'od zer/ mchod dpon/ phyag mdzod gnyis/ ban gtsang dbu mdzad sogs che 'dren thob pa rnams la grum ze bzang ba re/ ban gtsang pa byin dang / gzhan ma rnams la 'ja' gdan 'os bab re 'ding / khri chen gyi lho rtsa'i khri chung steng du chos las pa dang / chos 'khor lhun po'i bla ma/ khams lho brag gi 'bul dpon/ bsam yas rab byung bla ma rnams la 'bol grum re 'ding ba'i/ chos las pa dang chos 'khor lhun po'i bla ma kho rang tshos khyer yong / chos khri'i shar gyi khri chung steng du skya ho rnams la grum ze gzhung ma gcig dang 'jab gdan gcig dge 'dun tshogs pa byin gyis chos sde lho byang sogs rtsa grwa rnams la gdan yug ring bas gang khyed 'ding / dpon slob rnams khri steng du bzhugs gdan la bzhugs tshar ba dang / brda sprad nas tshogs pa tshang mas phyag 'bul byed/ de nas khri steng pa rnams la mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis mdo bsdud pa shog bu gsum bzhi re 'gyed/

tshogs chen la lho byang gi grwa shar bzhi lnga res chos skya spod dum pa re gral ring rnams kyi gsham du bskyal ba dge 'dun gral mgo ma rnams la rim pas bskul te thams cad la bkye tshar ba dang / ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas/ chos rnams bklogs tshar ba dang / tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mdo tshar gsum bdud bzlog dang bcas bskul tshar ba dang / ban gtsang dpon gyi mchod dpon smon lam rin chen/ dbu mdzad byams pa rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad kun dga' bsam gtan/ dbu mdzad ngag dbang rgyal mtshan rnams chos gos dras drub dang bcas langs nas/ phyag gsum btsal/ mchod dpon gyis maṇḍal sum cu so bdun ma btegs/ dbu mdzad byams pa rgya mtshos rgya spos lag tu thogs nas/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i maṇḍal so bdun ma gdangs dang bcas pas 'bul/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab ces pa'i dus rgya spos ri rab la 'dzugs/ de bzhin du shar lus 'phags po sogs brjod dus spos kyi brda sprod ma nor bar byed/ de nas dbus su btsugs te/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la theg pa chen po dam pa'i chos zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi sogs spyi 'gro /de nas gang gi mchod rdzas ma shar ma bskul nas phyag gsum btsal te gdan la 'khod tshar ba dang / gsol dpon rnams bsgrigs nas zhal dkar 'bul/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gis theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed gsal btab/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i che ba'i yon tan cung zad brjod nas/ rgyal sras lam bzang gi rgya gar skad du nas brtsam ste/ bstan bcos lus dngos kyi phar phyin drug gi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yan chad cha gsum du mdzad nas gnang ba'i gsum cha gcig song mtshams mang ja sngon ma'i dang po zhu ba yang thud ma shor tsam gyi bsus brda' gtong /

mang ja zhu ba dang bstun tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis ja mchod ngo mtshar phun tshogs ma bskul/ bsod nams dbang phyug gis cung zad sku ngal gsos/ gsol ja mchod grub mtshams sngar gyi chos 'phro cha gnyis su btang ba'i cha gcig gnang / de nas gung gseng mdzad pa'i tshogs chab thud ma shor ba gtong / de mthun bzhi thog tu nyung ja'i bsus brda' gtong ba dang / de nyin gyi zhal dkar 'bul tshan rnams bzhi thog tshoms chen nas tho rim bzhin bar thag snyoms shing bkod pa mdzes pa'i ngos bsgrigs te/ tshogs chen po'i shar sgor sleb pa byas/ gung seng tshogs 'phral nyung ja zhus te tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis ja mchod oṃ las ma bskul/ 'bul ba rnams shar sgo nas 'thon te tshogs kyi mtha' bskor nas khri chen mo'i steng du sleb pa dang bstun rim gyis 'bul lugs byas pa'i thog mar/ gsang yum gyis/ bkra shis kha btags/ rten thong / gos ser po kha do/ dmar po kha bzhi/ ljang khu kha lnga sbrel/ rgya dar yug sman rtse kha bdun 'brel/ sku gzan/ spun 'dabs/ long ki kha gsum/ ras khra yug gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ lha chen chos sde spyi pas bkras thags do sbrel/ dngul phor/ gser zho gsum/ rten thong / bla bre/ gos chen dmar po yug sman rtse kha bdun 'brel/ spa ri/ ras yol/ ka ci yug dgu tshan gnyis pa la/ bkras thags/ zhal dkar sngo khra che legs/ rag 'gag bcu khres/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ gos sngon kha bzhi sbrel/ lcags sgyid/ gos ber/ bur btags/ dkar yug dgu tshan gsum pa la/ bkras thags/ bla bre dngos gtsang / gos chen ser po yug ja 'u zi 'khor drug khrab/ gri/ lcags zhib/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ snye mo nas khri lcam yum sras kyis bkras thags kha sbrel/ sman rtse gsum sbrel/ sku 'dra rgya lha/ rten kheb/ ling kha brgyad sbrel/ sku gzan/ spangs kheb mtshon rdzogs/ khrab/ ras yug rnams/ yang mtshan gnyis pa la bkras thags/ gos chen kha sbrel/

bla bre/ spun 'dabs/ long ki kha phyed dang bzhi sbrel/ gon ma/ ras sngon kha bdun sbrel/ rta gcig dkar yug rnams/ lcam mus pas bkras thags/ dkar yol yu thung nyis mgo sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ dngul phor/ gos kha gsum sbrel/ ras khra yug kha ru kha brgyad sbrel/ spun 'dabs/ gon ma/ stag gdan/ ka ci yug rnams/ gling kha spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ dkar yol/ sman rtse kha phyed dang lnga/ gos dmar po kha gang / ras ser yug spa ri/ ras khra yug rag 'gag bcu khres/ khrab/ ling dom/ dkar yug srid gsum spyi pas bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rag 'gag lnga khres/ ling dom/ dkar yug khams drung gi spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ gos dmar po kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ shan dar ljang nag yug spar ri/ ras dmar yug dkar yol/ zangs shu/ ras sngo khra yug gon ma/ dkar yug cha zhabs kyi spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ gos dmar kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ shan dar ljang nag yug ras dmar yug spa ri/ dkar yol/ zangs shu ras sngo khra yug gon ma/ dkar yug kom 'dre ba'i spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ rten khebs/ sman rtse gsum sbrel/ dkar yol/ khrab/ rmog dkar sha gon ma/ dkar yug gling ga dbu mdzad kyis/ bkras thags/ gon chung / ras yug gling dga' byang 'dren pas bkras thags/ gos sngon kha/ sman rtse kha/ ling dom/ ras yug mkhar steng pas bkras thags/ sman rtse rag 'gag gcig g.yas shag ras nar pa/ ble lung spyi sa nas/ bkras thags/ ston pa'i gser sku/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ sman rtse'i dar chen/ li stibs/ mdza' go rmog gzhol ma/ ras sngon kha sbrel/ ras yug rnams/ zhe dgon spyi pas bkras thags/ ston pa'i gser sku/ gser zho long / rag 'gag gcig sman rtse kha/ byang dar dmar po/ ras kha sbrel rnams/ lung chung spyi pas bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rag 'gag gcig gos ser po kha gang / sngon po kha gang / snam bu/ ka to ra gcig gon ma/ ras yug sne tshang / zab mo bla spyis bkras btags/

sman rtse kha gang / rag 'gag ling chung / ras yug rnams/ sle lung bla mas/ bkras thags/ rten thong / gser zho longs/ gos dmar kha sbrel/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ rag 'gag bcu khres/ gos chen gyi stod thung / zangs thang / ras khra sne tshang / ling dom/ dkar yug dgon pa rdzong spyi sas/ bkras thags/ rten kheb/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ byang dar sngon po/ rag 'gag snam bu/ ras nar pa/ ya ma zur 'chad pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ rag 'gag gsum/ mar ril/ ka ci nar pa/ chos rje dgra lhas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gser zho longs/ sgar chen bde gshegs kyis sku gzan/ zangs zer/ ling dom/ ras yug bla ma'i sku/ dkar yol/ gling dga' zur 'chad pas/ bkras thags/ chos dung rten kheb/ sman rtse gsum sbrel/ hor ting bdun tshar/ ka to ra/ rag 'gag bcu khres/ mar ril gnyis/ gon chen/ dkar yug gling dga' mi dmangs kyis bkras thags/ gos stag shun kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse drug sbrel/ ras dmar kha bzhi/ pa ri/ mar ril gnyis/ ling dom/ ras yug 'dra 'bri spyi pas/ bkras thags/ rab dkar rtsa ring / rten kheb/ gos kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos sngo skya kha gang / yang sman rtse dom sbrel/ khrab/ ling dom/ ras yug dkar yug chog dkar lung pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rag 'gag bcu khres/ khyem gnyis/ kha sha ras kha lnga sbrel/ ka spyi yug chu bshod sgres pos/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ dkar yol/ ling dom/ dkar yug phyug don pa/ bar ble spe ba/ bar ble bsgres po gsum gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ ling dom/ dkar yug rdo rje rin chen gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ ling dom/ zangs zer/ gos chen kha do sbrel/ kha sha dkar yug 'phrang phu gzhung sogs kyi spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gos kha lnga sbrel/ ras khra/ yang ras khra yug ling dom/ dkar yug ra lung pa rnams kyis/ sman rtse/ byang dar/ gos chen/ yang sman rtse/ mon sle/ ras dkar nar pa/ la rtse spug pa/

phyug po nyams bu ba/ phyug po nyi zla/ 'og pa/ dkon mchog skyabs rnams kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ gon chung / dar kha/ ras yug 'phrang pa/ gnas 'og pa/ dkar po ba gsum gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse/ rmog gzhol ma/ ling dom/ dkar yug bkra shis sgang nas gzhol pa/ sgang pa/ tshong dpon spes rgan pa/ sgres po/ gsang khang pa drug gis bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ kha sha ras yug gzim chung pa/ gru brku ba/ dang ra ba/ nyi lde ba rnams kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ dar kha do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ kha sha ling chung / ras yug rnams/ tsha mer gnyis dang gung pa gsum gyis/ bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ dkar yol/ yang sman rtse kha/ gon chung / dkar yug zhu lung pa/ dpon che/ mkhar stabs pa rnams kyis/ dkar chan/ sman rtse/ btsun mo/ dar kha do/ spen thog cob ras/ dkar shong pa dang / gar phu pas/ btsun mo kha/ mtshon si/ ras kha lnga sbrel/ dbu rtse ba/ bar spe ba/ yon bdag pa gsum gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ rgya dar do sbrel/ dkar chen/ cob ras/ bkra bzang bla brang pas/ ston pa'i sku/ gser zho long / bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras sngon spar ma/ dkar yug dga' ldan rtse pa/ mkhar kha ba/ 'khris spe shar pa rnams kyis/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ rgya dar/ spun 'dab/ cab ras kha drug yul gsar ba/ sna spe ba/ dus mchod pa gsum gyis/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ tsaka sder/ gon chung / ras yug gzhung sa'i dmag las pa mthong phyug na thung pa/ ug rdho ba/ dpon drung rnams kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ dar sngon/ rgya dar do sbrel/ yang sman rtse kha/ spun 'dab/ ling dom/ kha sha dkar yug rnams byung zhing / dge 'dun pa rnams gung sang tshogs grub 'phral nyung ja bzhes bar nas bzung / gong bkod ltar gyi zhal dkar gyi 'bul ba rnams ma grub bar la/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug sku ngal gso ba'i ring / tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes sogs shlau ka gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i gong bstod rgyas pa rnams shar ma dang /

theg chen rin po che'i sku bstod shlau ka gcig nas/ rab mdzes ma shlau ka gcig yan gyi bla ma rnams kyi sku bstod shlau ka re mang ja rgyun pa'i chos spyod sgrigs rim ltar bskul/ de nas sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi sku bstod rgyas bsdus rnams shar ma/ rje mus chen gyi sku bstod gdangs ma/ spyan snga rin po che mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams kyi sku bstod/ nged rang gi brtan bzhugs bstod pa rnams dang / dkon mchog gsum dngos rje btsun khyed nyid la/ /sogs dang / khyod la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /sogs tshig bcad kha re song mtshams mang ja rting ma zhu ba de'i bsus brda' 'bul ba phyed lhag pa phul grub mtshams btang / ja mchod bskal bzang ma grub bstun sngar gyi chos 'phro rdzogs pa gnang ba'i ring la tshogs pa thams cad la chab btang / chos 'phro rdzogs pa'i/ lan dang gnas dang gtong ba dang / /sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar dag gsal snyan pa'i ngag gis brjod la/ 'o de rnams kyi sgo nas bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba 'di nyid kyi mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsam par dam bca' ba bstan bcos lus dngos kyi phar phyin drug gi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yan gyi legs par bshad pa rnams bstan zin pa yin pas de ring gi chos thun de la mdzad pa zhu/ gsungs pa dang / tshogs pa rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs dang / bdag gis dus gsum ma tshar gcig mdzad/ de nas thams cad gral la bzhugs nas mang ja gnyis kyi gnyis pa sdom nas zhu/ mchod grub 'phral chab btang la zhal dkar 'then/ de mthun tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis 'chi med dpal sbyin ma gzungs ring gsum 'dod gsol dang bcas pa/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/

/sogs kyi tshig sngon du 'gro bas tshe gzungs gang mang / mdo tshar gsum sogs rim gyis bskul nas mdzad pa'i ring la dpon slob rnams sngar bzhin gral bsgrigs nas rim gyis tshogs mtha' bskor nas bzhi thog tu phebs/ phebs skyel grub nas chos khrims pa rnams tshogs su sleb bstun chos spyod bsdus nas tshogs gyes// ༈ /nyi ma gnyis pa tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin yang tshogs dung dkar po rgyang grags gtong ba/ khrims pa rnams kyis sde la chos nyan gyi skad gtong zhing gdan 'dren la yong ba/ phyag phebs pa/ bla dung 'bud pa/ bzhugs khri la phyag mdzad nas khri khar phebs pa/ gral chos bkye ba/ mdo bskul zhing maṇḍal 'bul ba/ mang ja gnyis dang nyung ja zhu ba/ gung seng gtong ba/ gsung chos gnang lugs/ sku ngal gso ba/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis ja mchod dang chos spyod rnams bskul lugs sogs snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ gsung chos gnang lugs kha sang bzhin la/ bstan bcos lus dngos kyi brjod don phar phyin drug gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas brtsam ste/ sa lam gyi 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi sku gsum ye shes sogs kyi rnam gzhag gi legs bshad yan cha gsum du mdzad nas gnang / nyung ja thog 'bul ba rnams kyang gong bzhin bsgrigs nas 'bul lugs byas pa'i thog mar rgyal rtse nas bdag po bla ma'i drung gis/ bkra shis kha thags/ thub dbang gi sku 'bag bla bre/ dar dmar po yug sman rtse kha brgyad sbrel/ ras khra'i bla bre/ khrab cig rmog zangs 'khor/ lcags bsgyid/ sbril sngon yug gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ byang pa bla mas bkra shis kha thags/ gser zho longs/ dngul phor/ gos kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ sgril ma sngo ljang / ras dmar yug thung / gon chen/ rta/ ras dkar yug sne tshang / mdar brang mo che bla brang nas/ bkra shis pa'i kha thags/ tshe dpag med kyi sku/ gser zho longs/ rten khebs/ bla bre/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/

rab dkar rtsa ring / rag 'gag bcu 'khres/ ja bsigs/ rmog lcags sgyid/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ brang mo che spyi pas bkras thags/ sman rtse gsum sbrel/ gos kha do sbrel/ ja bar khag khrab rmog bse cham/ ling dom/ dkar yug gur pa slob dpon gyis/ bkra shis kha thags/ gos sngon po kha do sbrel/ rten khebs/ ja bsigs/ sman rtse bzhi sbrel/ khye dmar khra gsum sbrel/ zam zo yug spun 'dab/ rta gon chen/ dkar yug gur pa spyi pas/ bkras thags kha sbrel/ gdung rten/ sman rtse yug gos skyer kha yug thung / rten khebs/ bla bre/ ja spob rtse/ khrab/ grum rtse/ khro khor/ gon chen/ rta rkyang po/ dkar yug bskyid mtshal 'og pa'i 'bul ba/ bkras gsum sbrel/ rnam rgyal gyi sku/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sku gzan/ snam sbyar/ rten khebs/ gos dmar kha bcu/ sman rtse kha brgyad 'grel/ long ki ras yug khrab/ rta na gzhon/ dkar yug rnams/ yang mtshan gnyis pa la bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ sku gzan/ gos jus sngon kha do/ ka ras kha bcu/ spun 'dab/ dkar yug sne tshang / gru 'dzin bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis/ bkra shis kha thags/ ma cig gi li sku/ g.yu zhig gos kha sbrel/ sman rtse bzhi sbrel/ rag 'gag gsum/ zam zo kha brgyad 'brel/ yang sman rtse do sbrel/ rten khebs/ ras sngon kha brgyad 'brel/ ras dkar kha brgyad 'brel/ ral gri/ mar ril gnyis/ spu kha yug sne tshangs/ bskur mo'i 'bul ba dam chos rgyal mtshan gyis bkra shis kha thags/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku/ ras dmar kha sum cu so bzhi yug sman rtse kha/ gos kha/ spu ga yug sne tshang / dwags po grwa tshang bla mas bkras thags do sbrel/ gos skyer kha do sbrel/ rten khebs/ sman rtse bzhi sbrel/ ja bar khag bla bre/ ras dmar khri yug ling dom/ dkar yug rnams/ rtse chen lcam sring gis bsod nams kha thags/ rab dkar rtsa ring / rten khebs/ sman rtse bzhi sbrel/ long gi kha gsum sbrel/

ras sngon kha drug sbrel/ zam chen do sbrel/ khye gos sne tshang / rmog ma khrab/ spun 'dab/ gon chen/ dkar yug kha ba lhas kyi bla mas bkras thags/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sman rtse do sbrel/ gos dmar kha do sbrel/ rten khebs/ bla bre/ ras khra kha bzhi sbrel/ ling dom/ ras yug ya ma chos sdes/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ dkar yol/ rag 'gag snam bu/ spun 'dab/ mon ble/ mar ril/ ras yug rgyas bla mas/ bkras thags/ dkar yol rtsa ring / khrab/ rten khebs/ sman rtse bzhi sbrel/ gos kha/ gon chen/ ras yug dkar yug rnams/ yol gdong pa yum sras kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos kha sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / gos 'jab yag pa/ lcags sgyid/ dom lpags/ gon ma/ dkar yug mang mkhar bsam 'grub pas/ bkras thags/ dngul phor/ gos dmar kha phyed dang gsum sbrel/ gos lcags nag kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha bcu sbrel/ rten khebs/ yang sman rtse do sbrel/ ras sngon kha dgu sbrel/ ras dmar nar pa/ tsig ge yug ling dom/ gos kha do/ 'bras btang / gon chung / cab ras yug sde pa bskyed 'phrang pas/ bkras thags/ dkar yol rtsa ring / rten khebs/ sman rtse zung sbrel/ gon chen/ ras sngon yug dkar yug sde pa rma byas bkras thags/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku dbus li/ sman rtse/ gon chen/ ras yug mda' dpon bu khrid kyis bkras thags/ gos ser po kha sbrel/ sman rtse kha phyed dang gsum sbrel/ snam dkar nyis bub/ spun 'dabs/ gon ma/ ras yug grum rtse/ dkar yug thub bstan yangs can spyi sas/ bkras thags/ rten khebs/ sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ gos lu hang do sbrel/ bal chol/ spu kha bcu gcig sbrel/ gon ma/ dkar yug sne tshangs/ yangs can bla brang nas/ bkras thags/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku brnyan/ rten khebs dngos gtsang pa/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ gos mar khu mdog kha gsum sbrel/ ka to ra/ rus sbal 'khor lo lo skor bcu gnyis tshang ba'i ras khra/ gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/

thub bstan yangs can dkar po slob dpon gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ cab ras do sbrel/ gon 'bring / ras dkar kha bzhi sbrel/ yangs can khra mo slob dpon gyis/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ spun 'dab/ mon gle/ ras dkar lnga sbrel/ yangs can spyi pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ ling kha/ cab ras kha lnga sbrel/ ras yug sne tshangs/ bya bshongs bla spyis/ bkras thags/ rten thong / dkar yol/ gos kha gsum sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ras sngon/ ling chung / tsaka sder/ ras yug yang bkras thags/ ston pa'i sku/ rag 'gag sman rtse kha/ spun 'dab/ tsaka sder/ ras dkar kha bdun/ gser mdog can nas dgu tshan dang po la/ bkra shis kha thags che ba/ sgrol ma'i li sku mtho gang tsam/ rten khebs bzang sgrigs/ gos skyer kha kha phyed dang brgyad yug rgya gos 'brug ris ma/ sman rtse kha brgyad yug bla bre/ gon chen/ dkar yug sne tshang / dgu tshan gnyis pa la/ bkra shis kha thags/ rten khebs bzang sgrigs/ gos mtshal kha kha phyed dang bdun yug sman rtse kha drug sbrel yug sman rtse'i yol ba rnam pa bdun yod pa/ ras khra yug ka dan sngon po yug pho rta bzang ba/ ka ras yug sne tshang rnams/ bskyed lhas sgrub sdes bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ byang dar ljang khu kha bzhi sbrel/ rten khebs/ ras sngon yug sne tshang / spun 'dab/ ling chung / gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ yang bla brang nas dkar chen/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya dar kha gsum sbrel byang dar kha gang / spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ yang bla brang nas bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gon ma gnyis/ ka ci kha lnga sbrel/ bskyed lhas nas bla ma mtsho sgo bas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ ras dkar kha bdun sbrel/ gdong dga' spyi pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ sbug chol skyon med/ gon ma/ rmog ril/ zangs shu/ bla bre/ ras yug sne tshang / dkar yug khams pa dpon slob yongs kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ ras yug yang sman rtse kha sbrel/

rmog ril/ rag 'gag gcig yang sman rtse kha/ kha sha ling dom/ ras yug dkar yug 'bras yul skyid tshal nas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos kha sbrel/ snam dkar nyis bubs/ gon chen/ spun 'dab/ rta/ ras yug sne tshang / dkar yug bo gdong sku 'bum pas/ bkras thags/ mchod rten/ rten khebs/ spa ri/ sman rtse do sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / rag 'gag lnga khres/ spun 'dab/ cab ras yug lu pa spyi pas bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ spun 'dab/ ling dom/ ras yug rnams/ brag po che chos sde spyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ dkar chen/ yang sman rtse kha/ rgya dar kha gsum sbrel/ ras kha 'brel/ cab ras kha lnga sbrel/ sgrub sde spyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ snam dkar/ ling dom/ cab dar bzhi sbrel/ ras yug sne tshang / thub bstan dge 'phel spyi pa nas/ bkras thags/ rten khebs/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / tsig ge na/ ras dmar yug sman rtse do sbrel/ ras kha bdun sbrel/ ling chung / ras yug spun 'dab/ gon chen/ dkar yug rin chen sgang spyi pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya dar do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ling dom/ ras yug sne tshang / dkar yug sa bzang spyi pas/ dkar chen/ sman rtse kha/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug bsam 'grub dgon sar bas bkras thags/ sman rtse gsum sbrel/ bur btang / dkar yol/ yang sman rtse kha/ ras yug gon ma/ spun 'dab/ ras yug sne tshang / bka' sgros spyi pa nas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rag 'gag rgya dar sngon po kha/ ras yug sne tshang rnams/ rin chen sding pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ gos ling sngon po/ dkar yol rtsa ring / spun 'dab/ snam gsum ma/ dkar yug mda' rom pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug bkras sgang pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ rgya dar do sbrel/ ling dom/ dkar yug bla ma bsod nams chos bzang gis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ dar dkar/ gsol 'bras/

ka dan/ dkar yug kha lnga sbrel/ ras yug gnyer pa bsam gtan rin chen gyis/ bkras thags/ thong lcags/ rgya dar do sbrel/ ling chung / ras yug rnams/ bal dpon rgyab byang mas bkras thags/ rgya dar do sbrel/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gon ma/ ras yug rgyab byang drung 'tsho dang tshangs lags kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ ling chung / kha sha ras yug sne tshang / gon chen/ rab dkar rtsa ring / lcug stibs/ dkar yug kha brgyad sbrel/ brag dmar ba spyi'i 'bul ba/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ ka ras nar pa/ thub bstan rin chen gling spyi pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ kham bu/ rmog thong lcags/ gon chen/ ras yug sne tshang / na ring dgon pa spyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ gos chen kha/ dung dkar thong lcags/ snam dkar gnyis/ sga skor/ gon ma/ kham bu/ ras yug lo mthong / bkras sbug 'khris spe sogs kyi spyi 'bul/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ rgya dar/ spun 'dab/ ka ci nar pa/ gar kham pa spyi'i 'bul ba/ dkar chen/ sman rtse do sbrel/ dkar yol/ spun 'dab/ gon chung / sha khog mar phyur/ ras yug dkar yug kha'u 'brog pa'i spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ rten thong / gos ser po kha bzhi sbrel/ rgya dar yug sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ sgril sngon yug ras dmar yug dkar yug chu shod phul chung gi spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha do/ snam dkar gnyis/ lu phu bla brang 'og nas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gser sku/ gser zho long / dkar yol rtsa ring / mon ble/ gon chen/ cab ras kha bcu gcig yug dpon gnyer sangs rgyas don 'grub kyis/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ rgya dar do sbrel/ ras kha do/ ling chung / bsod nams dpal grub kyis dkar chen/ sman rtse kha/ rgya dar do sbrel/ ras kha gsum/ ling chung / phyug po stod lung pas bkra shis kha thags kha bzhi sbrel/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku/ sman rtse yug dngul phor/ gser zho long / gos kha do sbrel/ ras yug gnyis/

rta na gzhon/ gon chen/ dkar yug sne tshang / yang bkra shis kha btags/ mtsho sgo chos sde bla mas bkras thags/ gu ru rin po che'i sku 'dra/ sman rtse do sbrel/ byang dar kha gru/ gon chen/ kha sha cab ras yug gzhis dga' rtse nas sde pa nor bu'i drung gis/ bkra shis kha btags che ba/ rten khebs/ sman rtse kha bcu yug bla bre/ gos mchin kha kha bcu gnyis yug sgril sngon kha bcu yug gon chen/ rta rag pa/ ka ras yug rnams byung zhing / de nas gsol gnyis zhu ba/ zhal dkar 'then pa/ bzhi thog tu phebs pa sogs gong bzhin las/ de nyin gyi gsung chos rdzogs mtshams sku gsum ye shes kyi rnam gzhag rnams song mtshams su slebs pa dang / 'o de rnams kyi sgo nas bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba 'di nyid kyi bstan bcos lus dngos kyi phar phyin drug gi shes rab kyi phar phyin nas brtsams te/ sa lam gyi 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi sku gsum ye shes sogs kyi rnam gzhag gi legs bshad rnams bstan zin pa yin pas/ de ring gi chos thun de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs snga ma dang 'dra zhing / de nas gsol ja rnams rdzogs rjes gsol dkar bsdus te gong bzhin rim pas bzhi thog tu phebs so// ༈ /nyi ma gsum pa tshes bco lnga'i snga dro tshogs dung gtong ba sogs gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra ba las/ nged rang yab sras gnyis char phebs pa'i/ gsol dpon sgrigs rim gyi grwa la nged rang gi rgyun pa'i ma chen dge slong kun dga' bzod pa 'gro ba dang / nged rang gi g.yas g.yon gyi phyag 'degs la rgyun pa'i nye 'khor ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa dpal 'byor dang / bsod nams rab brtan gyis bgyi shing / gos bem khrom zil gnon 'khyer mi ban gtsang dpon gyi dbu mdzad dge slong chos 'od zer gyis bgyis te/ gzhan ma bzhi thog nas bca' sgrigs nas phebs lugs/ bla dung gtong ba/

chos khri'i steng du phebs pa sogs thams cad snga ma bzhin la/ de'i snga dro snga ba'i cha la mon chung pu tra'i mgon khang du thug kha gsos/ gtor gsos tsam bre gang / dkar rgyan bzhi cha ma/ dmar rgyan mtshon tsam/ spyan gzigs lham chung gsum/ gos chung pho gos gnyis dang mo gos gcig dar kha gang / khro khang 'og tu a ma dho skyong ma la gtor gsos tsam bre phyed/ dkar rgyan dmar rgyan yod tsam/ snyan dar ras kha gang / gnyis ka thun mong du mchod 'bru bre gang / nag me bre phor gang rnams 'bul/ de nas la shar nub kyi grong mi'i nas mar rnams tshogs kyi shar sgo/ nub sgo rnams su bkyes/ khro khang gi steng du gzim gur phub ste zhal bkod pa rnams phebs/ phyi nang gi 'bul ba gda' rnams gang yod kho gang gi shar dang / byang gi thog nas rgya khra'i steng du 'phyang 'phrul la bsgrigs/ 'gyed byin po tshogs kyi khri chung lho ma'i mtshams nas shar sgo'i bar gyang gas sogs gang bder bkod/ tshogs pa dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang / skye bo'i tshogs rnams sgo gsum nas nang la 'byon dus nas mar 'gyed/ tshogs pa 'byon pa'i rgya sgo rnams su nang zan rgyugs thogs pa gsum bzhi re bzhag nas 'grim 'grul gcod/ khri chung lho'i gyang gas sogs su dngos po rnams bsrung ba dang / tshogs nang nas phyir gling gi ze brgyud phyin dogs bsrung mi yang bzhog khro gang steng gi zhal bkod pa rnams dang / nang gzan tshang ma la dkar yol btang zhing nyung ja rnams 'dren/ de nyin mang ja gsum dang nyung ja gcig gnang ba'i/ mang ja sngon ma'i dang po maṇḍal 'bul gong zhu/ bsus brda' khri khar phebs 'phral gtong / de gong du mchod dpon gyis mdo bsdud pa 'gyed pa/ gsung sgrogs gnang ba/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis mdo bskul ba rnams nyi ma snga ma ltar grub rjes mang ja zhus te/ ja mchod bskul nas/ dpon slob kun gyis gsol ja mchod grub 'phral mchod dpon ban gtsang pa'i dbu mdzad rnams dang tshogs chen dbu mdzad sogs la chab btang nas gong bzhin maṇḍal phul/

ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gis thub pa dgongs gsal gyi bstan bcos lus dngos kyi sa lam gyi 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gi yon tan gyi chos phye ste bshad pa nas brtsam ste rgyal sras lam bzang gi sbyar byang smon lam rdzogs so dang bcas tshang la ma nor ba zlos skyon med cing / tshig gi lhad cung zad tsam yang med par yongs su rdzogs pa gnang bas/ shes ldan kun ngo mtshar zhing dad pa'i spu long g.yo bas kun gyis snyan pa brjod par gyur to/ /de nas gsung chos gnang grub pa dang / zhes pa de rnams kyis bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston mtha' dag spel zin pa yin pas/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs snga ma rnams dang 'dra bar byas la/ der rjes gung sang gnang nyung ja'i bsus brda' btang zhing 'bul ba rnams sgrigs tshom sngar ltar byas/ gung sang tshogs 'phral nyung ja zhu ba dang tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis ja mchod bskul/ zhal dkar bteg bstun 'bul tshan rnams rim gyis 'bul ba'i thog mar lha sa nas mchod yon gyis mi sna mdu lung pa langs te/ 'bras spungs sprul skus bkra shis kha btags che ba/ dkar gangs ser po shub bcas/ rten kheb/ bkras thags kyi bla bre/ gan gos gzhi dmar yug sman rtse yug chor rtsi sngo skya yug rta/ cob ras yug yang bkrags che ba dngul phor/ rgya dril rdo rje shub bcas/ sman rtse yug kha thi sngo khra yug ja 'khor drug gdan dmar/ rta/ cob ras yug rnams/ yang rgyal po'i bkras thags/ bla bre/ ri 'gag kha thi dmar khra yug sman rtse yug ras khra leb/ zab so/ rta/ ras yug rnams/ yang phyag mdzod pas bkras thags/ rten khebs/ gser thags kyi bla bres mthong / sman rtse yug gos gzhi ser tshon khra yug chor ljang yug bur btang bzung / rta/ ras dkar yug yang bkra shis lhun po nas/

gsol ja thog bkra shis kha btags/ rten khebs/ bla bre/ bshan mtshon si yug gos yug sman rtse yug ja 'khor gsum/ zam so yug gon chen/ rta/ ka ras yug bsam yas mkhan tshangs pas/ chos skyong chen po'i bzhugs gdan gnyis/ bkras thags 'dom 'khor ma gnyis/ dgu tshan gnyis kyi thog mar bkras thags 'dom 'khor ma/ sman rtse kha bcu yug ling sngon po kha bzhi sbrel/ gos dkar po kha bcu bzhi yug gos zangs sgrigs kyi rten khebs/ bla bre/ ka ras kha lnga sbrel/ ling dom/ ras yug rnams/ dgu tshan gnyis kyi dang po/ bkras thags 'dom 'khor ma/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos mchin kha do sbrel/ gos dmar po bkra shis rtags brgyad ma kha gsum sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon chen/ ras yug rta na gzhon rkyang po/ dkar yug dbu rtse bla brang nas/ bsod nams kha thags/ gser zho gang / sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ gos dmar kha drug sbrel/ ja bar khag ras sngon kha bdun sbrel/ zangs 'khor gcig ras ljang yug dkar yug rnams/ yang bkras thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ gos kha do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ras sngon yug ja bar khag ka ras yug kha lnga sbrel/ rab byung spyi pas bsod nams kha thags/ gos stag ris ma yug sman rtse kha drug sbrel/ bshan dar dmar po kha drug sbrel/ yag chu mgo khag ding dpon kha gang lhag tsam/ si gcig 'u zi 'khor drug gnyis/ dkar yug zung mkhar sle sbus pa'i/ kha rtags sman rtse/ spen bub/ ras dkar kha bdun sbrel/ ras chen yug zungs mkhar mchod gzhis spyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ ka ras kha bzhi sbrel/ ja mgo khag snam dkar bub/ rtse gdong nas sku mched kyis gsol ja thog bkra shis kha thags/ dngul phor/ bzang sgrigs kyi rten khebs/ spos rgya bam/ gu gu sha'i ka to ra/ gan gos bzang sgrigs kyi bla bre spus gtsang ba/ spos dra che legs/ gan jus tshon khra yug ja bsigs/ sman rtse yug byang rta bzang ba/ spa ri/ dre'u/ ras dmar yug tshugs mi/ ka dan sngon po yug dkar yug

ngor bla brang nas 'bul tshan dang por/ bkra shis kha btags che ba/ rten khebs/ bla bre/ gos lu hang yug sman rtse yug ja 'u zi 'khor drug ma/ khye sngo khra'i yol ba/ man krong me tog ma yug sne tshang / sman rtse yug chibs pa dkar po bzang ba/ tshan gnyis pa la bkras thags do sbrel/ rten khebs/ bla bre/ gos dmar po me tog ma yug sne tshang / spun 'dab/ ras yug ka ci yug ras khra yug spa ri legs pa/ lho ras yug spun 'dab/ ka ci yug sne tshang / yang thar rtse nas/ bkra shis kha thags/ gser sku/ gos dmar kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ ras dmar yug gon ma/ mo drel yag pa/ ras dkar yug khams pa bla ma dbon po dgra bos/ bkras thags/ rten khebs/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ ras dmar yug gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ shangs rgya tsho bas/ bkra shis kha thags 'doms 'khor ma/ gos chen kha thi kha/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ rgya dar bum gdan ma leb/ spun 'dab/ cob ras yug ras yug yang lha khang mkhan chen gyis/ dgu tshan dang po la bkra shis kha thags/ dngul phor/ rten thong / sku 'gag mchod ras khra bo/ jus dmar mthong byas pa'i bla bre/ shan dar yug stod ras sngo khra yug gon chen/ ka ci yug rnams/ dgu tshan gnyis pa la/ bkras thags/ rag 'gag bcu khres/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ gos nyis tshos yug sbril sngon/ ras khra yug zangs shu/ gon chen/ ka ci yug rnams/ dgu tshan gsum pa la/ bkras thags/ rten thongs/ sman rtse yug bshan dar sngon po yug lcags sgyid/ zangs chen/ ras dmar yug gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ brgya dpon dge 'dun rin chen gyis/ bkra shis kha thags/ 'khrungs rabs po ti/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ bshan tshon si kha gsum sbrel/ gos bem ras sngo khra yug zangs rkyan/ ras sngon yug khrab dpung bskor ma/ ras dmar khra yug ras khra yug gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ las chen ra chen pas/ bkras thags/ thub pa'i gser sku/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos chen do sbrel/

rten khebs/ rta sga/ spun 'dab/ ling dom/ ras yug yang las chen gzhon pas/ bkras thags/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ rgya dar kha/ byang dar ser po/ dkar yol rtsa ring / spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug yang chos 'khor lhun po'i bla mas/ bkras thags/ gos sngon kha phyed do/ spa ri kha do sbrel lhag tsam/ dngul phor/ bka' khru/ ras yol dngos gtsang / gon chen/ spu kha yug ja bar khag spa ri/ ka ci yug gnyis rnams/ yang chos 'khor lhun po nas bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ tsi kha yug spa ri/ dkar yug sne tshang / dbu mdzad chos 'od kyis bkras thags 'dom 'khor ma/ sman rtse skya khra kha gsum sbrel/ byang dar ljang khu kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse mtshon tshogs kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse ser khra kha gsum sbrel/ rab dkar rtsa ring / sgril sngon/ gon chen/ dkar yug mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis bkra shis kha btags/ ston pa'i sku/ gser zho do/ dkar yol rtsa ring / gos chen kha bdun sbrel/ bla bre/ sman rtse kha bcu sbrel/ ras dmar drug sbrel/ zangs zer/ rmog lcags sgyid/ zangs 'khor/ ras khra yug gon ma/ dkar yug gnyer pa bsod nams rdo rjes bkra shis kha thags 'dom 'khor ma/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku/ gser srang phyed/ sku gzan gnyis/ gos chen kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha bcu gnyis sbrel/ zangs zer/ rmog khrab/ ras yug lcags sgyid/ zangs 'khor/ gon chen/ dkar yug 'tsho byed rtsa brgyad pas bkras thags/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i sku 'dra phyag nas dngos ma/ gos kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse kha/ li stibs/ ras sngon kha bzhi sbrel/ sgril ljang / gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ phyag mdzod byams pa dpal 'byor gyis/ bkra shis kha thags 'dom 'khor ma/ rten thong pa'i zla ba zho 'khor bzung / ling skyer kha kha phyed dang bdun sbrel/ gos sngon po kha brgyad sbrel/ sman rtse kha brgyad sbrel/ shan dar sngon po kha dgu sbrel/

sman rtse skya khra kha bzhi sbrel/ spa ri ser khra/ long ki kha bzhi sgril/ sgril sngon yug sgril ljang yug zangs 'khor/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyis/ bkras thags 'dom 'khor ma/ thub dbang gi sku brnyan/ rten mthong / sa'i zla ba zho 'khor bzungs/ gos dmar kha lnga sbrel/ ling ser po kha lnga sbrel/ sman rtse tshon rdzogs kha bdun sbrel/ skya khra kha bzhi sbrel/ byang dar sngon po kha drug sbrel/ zangs shu/ sgril sngon yug dmar po yug ljang khu yug gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ ma chen kun dga' bzod pas bkra shis kha thags/ gos sngon po kha sbrel/ sman rtse kha do sbrel/ dar sngon kha gsum sbrel/ byang dar kha/ spun 'dab/ zangs zer/ ras khra yug ras yug ling dom/ dkar yug dbu mdzad byams pa rgya mtshos/ bkras thags dngul mdog ma/ sman rtse kha phyed dang do/ rab dkar rtsa ring / gos kha/ thong lcags/ spun 'dab/ rmog gzhol ma/ ling dom/ dkar yug dbu mdzad kun dga' bsam gtan gyis/ bkras thags/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sman rtse kha/ gos kha/ dar kha/ ling dom/ cob ras yug dbu mdzad ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ gos dmar kha/ byams pa'i rag sku/ spun 'dab/ kham bu/ cob ras rnams/ dbu mdzad kun dga' sbyin pas/ btsun mo kha/ sman rtse kha/ mdo dar kha gsum sbrel/ gon ma/ lho ras sne tshang / spyi chen gyis bkras thags/ dkar yol/ gos lu hang do sbrel/ sman rtse do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ thong lcags/ kha sha gon ma/ dkar yug spyi pa las thog pas/ dkar chen/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ byang dar/ spun 'dab/ zangs rkyan/ gon ma/ ka ras yug rnams/ rang byon chos rjes bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ mtshon si kha phyed dang do/ gon ma/ dkar yug tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis/ bkras thags/ gos chen kha do sbrel/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya ras kha bzhi sbrel/ gon ma/ spun 'dab/ dkar yug rnams/ chos khrims pas/ dkar chen/ sman rtse kha/ rten thongs/

ling dom/ ras yug bde chen gling dbu mdzad kyis/ sman rtse kha/ rten khebs/ ras yug chos khrims pas sman rtse/ tsaka sder/ ras nar pa/ bsreg shing chos rjes bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ gos nyis tshos kha phyed dang do/ gon ma/ ras yug dge slong bstan pa dar rgyas kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ byang dar kha gang / ling kha gang / ras ser/ gon chen/ ka lci rnams/ chos nyid rin chen gyis/ bkras thags/ gos kha sbrel/ ling kha gang / sman rtse do sbrel/ ras dmar/ ling dom/ ka ci/ chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ gos kha sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / ras khra yug gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ chos mdzad dge 'dun dpal 'byor gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ long ki ras sngon/ gos chen kha phyed dang bzhi sbrel/ kha sha spun 'dab/ ling dom/ dkar yug sne tshang / drung chen byams pa dpal 'byor gyis/ bkras thags/ gos dmar po kha lnga sbrel/ gos ljang kha do/ sman rtse kha bdun sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon chen/ dkar yug mchod dpon ngag dbang dpal bzang gis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ mtshon si do sbrel/ gon chung / ras yug lha khang rtse dkon gnyer gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos lu hang kha/ rgya dar gsum sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ling dom/ ras yug chos rin chen/ nor bu rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' grags pa rnams kyis/ bkras thags/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sman rtse do sbrel/ ling sngo skya/ gon chen/ ras yug dkar yug kun dga' rnam dpyod kyis bkras thags/ gos kha/ sman rtse kha/ rab dkar rtsa ring / ras yug dbu mdzad zla 'od kyis bkras thags/ rten khebs/ sil snyan/ ka to ra/ spun 'dab/ rmog mdun khrab/ gon chung / ras nar pa/ byas 'gyur sgrub dpon gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ spun 'dab/ ling chung / ras yug chos rgya mtsho/ byams pa dpal 'byor/ brtson 'grus rin chen/ kun dga' skyabs pa/ rdor dkar ba rnams kyis bkra shis kha thags/

sman rtse kha/ rgya dar/ rag 'gag ras chen yug sgo rum/ dbu rtse/ nang po rnams kyi sku gnyer gyis/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ rgya dar do sbrel/ gon chung / ka ci rnams/ bde mchog sku gnyer gnyis kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ mtshon si do sbrel/ thong lcags/ ras yug bzhi thog sku gnyer gsum/ gsol ja khang chen mo'i ja dpon rnams kyis dkar chen/ sman rtse do sbrel/ thong lcags/ kha sha spun 'dab/ rgya dar bzhi sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / gon ma/ dkar yug bsam gtan rgyal mtshan dang / bsam gtan dpal 'byor gnyis kyis/ sman rtse/ dar kha/ ras nar pa/ dge sding gnyer pas bkras thags/ sman rtse kha drug sbrel/ yang do sbrel/ gon ma/ spun 'dab/ dkar yug rnams/ gling dga' drung chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ long gi kha bzhi sbrel/ rgya zam kha bcu gcig sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon chen/ ras yug drung chen sangs rgyas 'od zer gyis/ bkras thags/ rab dkar rtsa ring / gos ding sar kha do/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ ras yug srid gsum gnyer pas bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos chen kha gang / rgya dar do sbrel/ ras yug ling dom/ ka ci yug rma bya gnyer pas/ bkras thags/ rten khebs/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sman rtse do sbrel/ gos dmar kha/ gon ma/ ka ci yug rting skyes pa dpal rtse na yod pas/ gsol ja thog bkra shis kha thags/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku 'dra phyag nas dngos ma/ rten mthong / gos sang kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ spun 'dab/ rya ko gon chen/ ras yug rgya rgan pa'i dgu tshan dang po la bkras thags/ dngul phor/ gos dmar po kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse yug 'bal thugs kyi ma khrab/ byang dar ljang khu do sbrel/ gon chen/ lho ras yug rta pho chen/ ka ras yug rnams/ dgu tshan gnyis pa la/ bkras thags/ gos skyer kha kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha drug sbrel/ rmog gzhol ma/ khrab do sham ma/

sman rtse skya khra kha do sbrel/ sbril ljang yug spun 'dab/ gon ma/ ras yug sne tshang rnams/ spel bas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / rten khebs/ kha ru kha gsum sbrel/ gon chen/ khrab zangs 'khor/ ka ci yug rnams/ dgu tshan gnyis pa la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ka spyi yug gon chen rnams/ rang byon pas bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ gos ling kha sbrel/ rgya dar do sbrel/ dngul phor/ spun 'dab/ ras sngon/ gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ sgrol ma phug pas bkras thags/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ sbug chol/ gos chen sngon po kha sbrel/ ja bar khag ling dmar po kha phyed dang gsum/ gos lu hang kha gsum sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ ka dan sngon po kha brgyad sbrel/ ka ci yug ka drug mas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ gon ma/ ja bar khag lho ras yug khrab dpung 'khor ma/ dkar yug sne tshang / bkras rtse pas bkras thags/ dngul phor/ sman rtse do sbrel/ khrab/ kha sha rgod ma gcig dkar yug sgang chen pas bkras thags/ dngul phor/ rten khebs/ gos ser po yug sman rtse yug long ki sgril sngon yug lcags bsgyid/ ras yug dkar yug rnams/ chos ldan gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ bzhugs 'ding / gon chung / cob ras rnams/ thub bstan rnam rgyal bla brang nas bkra shis kha thags/ ston pa'i gser sku/ gos kha sbrel/ sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ ras dmar yug ras sngo khra yug ras dmar khra yug sbril ljang yug dre'u/ lcags zhibs/ gon ma/ lho ras/ dkar yug brag dmar chos sde ba'i dgu tshan gsum gyi thog mar bkra shis pa'i kha thags/ tshe dpag med kyi sku/ gos bzang sgrigs kyi rten khebs/ yang bzang sgrigs kyi bla bre/ gan jus dmar po yug thung / sman rtse yug ras sngon yug ras khra yug ka ci yug rnams/ dgu tshan gnyis pa la dben rtsa kha thags/ gos bzang sgrigs kyi rten khebs/ gos mtshal kha yug thung / sman rtse yug ras khra padma 'dab brgyad can/

ras sngon yug rta/ gon chen/ dkar yug rnams/ dgu tshan gsum pa la/ bkra shis kha thags/ gos bzang sgrigs kyi rten khebs/ yang bzang sgrigs kyi bla bre/ gos skyer kha kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse yug ling ljang khu kha phyed dang drug sbrel/ zam zo skyer kha yug ras sngon yug dkar yug rnams/ yag chos gdan sa pas/ bkras thags/ ston pa'i sku/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya dar do sbrel/ sgril sngon sne tshang / spun 'dab/ yang sgril ma mi sha kha drug sbrel/ ling dom/ dkar yug yag chos spyi sos bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ sgril sngon sne tshang / rag 'gag gcig kha sha ka ras brgyad sbrel/ sgyi chu spyi sos bkras thags/ ston pa'i gser sku/ rten khebs/ sman rtsi kha/ rag 'gag zangs zer/ dkar yug phu gsum spyi sos bkras thags/ 'jam dbyangs gser sku/ rgya dar kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ras yug tsaka sder/ zangs stibs/ ras dkar nar pa/ dgon pa rgyas spyi sos/ bkras thags/ ston pa'i sku/ sman rtse kha/ ras sngon kha sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ ka ci kha bdun sbrel/ kun dga' don grub kyis bkras thags/ gos kha/ sman rtse kha/ thong lcags/ ras yug gru kha nang pas bkras rtags 'dom 'khor ma/ gser zho longs/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ kha thags yug gos kha/ rgya dar bzhi sbrel/ ka to ra/ rmog lcags sgyid/ tsaka sder/ dkar yug bag ru rgya dpon gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya dar gsum sbrel/ rab dkar rtsa ring / mar phyur ba/ long ki ras yug gnyis/ gon ma/ dkar yug ko lcag dkar sbug pas bkras thags/ gso kha/ sman rtse kha/ gon ma/ ras yug rnams/ khang khung pas bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ ka to ra/ ling chung / ras dkar nar pa/ gnas bcu dpon gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ stod ras/ gon chung / ka ras/ ko lcag la shar pa'i spyi 'bul la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ kha sha ras kha do/ tsaka sder bdun/ la nub pa'i spyi 'bul/ sman rtse kha/ sdem thag lnga/

ra rgod/ khum bu bzhi rnams/ rma bya ba'i spyi 'bul bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya dar kha bzhi sbrel/ zam zo kha lnga sbrel/ rmog ka to ra/ spun 'dab/ gon chen/ dkar yug gzim dpon steng 'og gnyis kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gos kha/ rgya dar do sbrel/ ras khra/ ling dom/ ras yug chu shar pa'i bcu dpon gnyis dang rdo chung pas bkras thags/ sman rtse kha do/ spun 'dab/ snam dkar rnams/ lha gdong 'phrang 'og gi spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ snam dkar brgyad/ shab pa'i spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ gos mon mdog kha gsum sbrel/ ras sngo khra yug khrab dpung skor ma/ dkar yol/ ras dmar yug gon ma/ dkar yug bla brang g.yu gzhu pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ skya chen/ bshan mtshon si/ ka ci kha gsum sbrel/ ras yug sne tshang / shar chen pas bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ dkar yol rtsa ring / ling sngon kha sbrel/ ston pa'i sku/ mdo dar yug zangs chen/ lcags sgyid/ zangs zer/ ling dom/ ras yug rnams/ don chen rgan pas/ bkras thags/ rten thong / gos kha bzhi sbrel/ sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ gos ling kha bdun sbrel/ rgya dar kha do sbrel/ khum bu/ zam zo kha bzhi sbrel/ ras yug khro khor/ dkar yug rnams/ bon gong pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ gos kha/ rgya dar do sbrel/ long ki sbril sngon/ sgril ljang / gon ma/ dkar yug gnyer pa dpal 'byor gyis bkras thags/ rgya dar do sbrel/ sman rtse do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ dkar yol rtsa ring / ling dom/ dkar yug rnams/ gnyer pa bsam 'grub kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ rgya dar kha gsum sbrel/ dkar yol/ byang dar sngon po kha sbrel/ spun 'dab/ dkar yug mgron gnyer tshe dbang gis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ gos kha sbrel/ ras sngon/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ mgron gnyer dngos grub kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ shan dar kha spun 'dab/ khum bu/ gon ma/

dkar yug rta dpon rnam rgyal gyis bkras thags/ gos sngon kha sbrel/ dkar yol/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ sbril sngon/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ dpal ldan gyis bkras thags/ gos kha sbrel/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug rnams/ sri thar gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ rgya dar bzhi sbrel/ ras khra yug spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug gsang sngags pho brang nas zhal lta ma gnyis kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ rgya dar do sbrel/ yang kha gang / spun 'dab/ ling dom/ ras yug nor bu lhas sbyin gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gon chung / kha sha dkar yug grags rin dang nor bu rin chen gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ rgya dar kha/ spun 'dab/ kha sha ling chung / dkar yug bzo bo mgon pos bkras thags/ sman rtse/ rgya dar kha/ ling chung / ras yug lha ris pa bka' bcu/ chos 'phel grags pa/ tshe brtan dpal 'byor/ bkra shis don pa/ rdor lags rnams kyis/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras dkar/ yang sman rtse/ dar dmar kha/ ras yug rnams/ ma chen mgon tshe/ dar rgyas/ sprang spug gsum gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ rgya dar do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ kha sha rag 'gag long ki yug ling dom/ dkar yug gu ru dar rgyas kyis dkar chen/ sman rtse/ ras khra/ ling dom/ ras yug mi dpon bzhis bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ dkar yol/ ras dmar yug ra rgod/ yang sman rtse kha/ ling chung / gon ma/ dkar yug gsum pa/ nor bu tshe ring / dbu rgyan gsum gyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ rgya dar kha sbril/ ling chung / ras yug tshe ring / sgye ma/ nor bu/ rgya gar rnams kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha do/ rgya dar sbrel/ spun 'dab/ kha sha ras yug dpal rdo rjes bkras thags/ sman rtse/ shan dar/ ling dom/ ras yug dres pa a drung brgyad kyis bkras thags/ rten khebs/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ ras khra yug spun 'dab/ gon ma/ ras yug bzhon ma byang mas/ mtshon si/ gon chung / ras kha bzhi/ bzhon ma lho mas/ dkar chen/ sman rtse/

ras kha bzhi sbrel/ tshe bkras/ dar rgyas rgyal po/ bsod nams don grub/ bkra shis dar rgyas rnams kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse/ spun 'dab/ shan dar/ ras yug gon ma/ dkar yug bsam 'grub dang sngod rgyab pa gnyis kyis/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras yug dkar yug rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar sum dar/ tshe ring don grub/ sgo lnga bkra shis/ phyug 'dzom/ nor bzang / rtse mo ba/ me 'bud don 'grub/ rig sing pa rnams kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse do sbrel/ spun 'dab/ ling chung / ras yug gon ma/ dkar yug bar rdzi gnyis kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gon chen/ mgar ba sngo thong pas/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug a bskyed kyis bkras thags/ sman rtse/ dkar yol/ rgya dar/ ras yug sku mdun rgyal gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ spun 'dab/ gon chung / ras yug sne tshang / 'tsho byed bsam pa don gyis bkras thags/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ gos ling kha/ byang dar sngon po kha/ rgya dar kha sbrel/ ras khra kha bdun sbrel/ spun 'dab/ gon ma/ dkar yug sne tshang / sgrel po lnga 'phel gyis/ bkras thags/ dkar yol rtsa ring / sman rtse do sbrel/ gon ma/ dkar yug sne tshang / dpon yig bkra shis don 'grub kyis/ bkra shis kha thags/ gos dmar po kha sbrel/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ ras ljang kha lnga sbrel/ spun 'dab/ dkar yol rtsa ring / ras sngon kha bdun sbrel/ ling dom/ dkar yug sne tshang rnams byung zhing / de ltar gong gi zhal dkar gyi 'bul ba de rnams grub mtshams/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang lugs gnyis kyi rten 'brel rang 'grig tu gyur pa'i rang rtags su/ thob rgyag gi tshul du smon 'gro nas dpon drung gi zhal dkar zhu mi yar 'phel bkra shis 'byor pa'i thog mar bkra shis kha thags 'dom 'khor ma/ gos chen dmar po kha sbrel/ dngul phor/ gos chen ljang khu kha gsum sbrel/ sman rtse kha lnga sbrel/ spun 'dab/ sbril sngon yug gon chen/ dkar yug sne tshang rnams byung ba yin/

de nas gong 'khod ltar gsol ja mchod grub 'phral tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro bas/ nged rang gi bstod pa 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma gdangs ma bskul/ de nas brtan bzhugs/ ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung kun dga' ba'i/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dang / bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig bcad rnams brgya rtsa re/ gzhan ma brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad kha yar dang bcas pa song mtshams/ mang ja bar ma'i dang po zhu ba'i bsus brda' thud ma shor ba gtong / ja mchod bskul zhing gsol ja mchod grub bstun/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /sogs kyi tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bstod rnams snga ma bzhin bskul nas mdzad/ sngags 'chang chen po'i bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs ma gdangs ma/ shes bya kun la ma dang / byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ de nas byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma gdangs ma dang / grags pas mkha' khyab ma/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs ma/ de nas spyan snga rin po che dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ nged rang gi bstod pa rnams sogs rgyun pa'i chos spyod bzhin gzhung bsrings nas rdzogs mtshams mang ja rting ma'i dang po zhu ba'i bsus brda' thud bcu drug nas gtong / ja mchod he ru ka dpal ma gnang / gsol ja mchod grub 'phral 'chi med dpal sbyin ma bskul nas/ gzungs ring gsum 'dod gsol dang bcas mdzad/ de nas 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /sogs kyi tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro bas tshe gzungs nyer lnga tsam dang / sgrol ma gsum rnams sogs mtshams gung sang mdzad/ tshogs 'phral mang ja gsum char gyis gnyis pa sdom nas zhu/ de nas mdo tshar dgu bdud bzlog dang bcas grub bstun/ 'gro la bde skyid ma nas bzung / smon lam bkra shis sogs kyi tshigs bcad rnams shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas rdzogs mtshams tshogs chen dbu mdzad gdan la bsdad/

de nas sa skya dpon yig pas rtsi gos gyon nas khro khang steng gi byang shar gyi zur du langs te 'bul ba gda' rnams rim pas gtong ba ni// ༈ /thog mar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i nang rten dngul gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i drung dang / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal rnams la snyan dar bkra shis kha btags 'dom 'khor ma gcig yang bkra shis kha thags bzhi/ dngul byus rgyan gzhi ma sogs yug re/ dkar me skyogs bcu re/ zhal zas bcu re/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sku 'dra sku tshad ma rnams la snyan dar kha re/ dkar me skyogs lnga re/ zhal zas lnga re/ dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ snam sbyar spus gtsang ba/ dkar me skyogs bcu/ zhal zas bcu/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i rten gtso sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi gser sku/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gser sku/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sman sku rnams la snyan dar kha re/ dkar me skyogs bcu re/ zhal zas bcu re/ rgyal yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo'i nang rten dngul gdung drung du snyan dar sman rtse kha gsum sbrel/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ bdag po mthu stobs drung sku mched kyi dngul gdung drung du snyan dar kha re/ dkar me skyogs lnga re/ zhal zas lnga re/ rnam thar sgo gsum du snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ sku 'dra rme ba can gyi drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha thag che legs/ bdag nyid chen po'i sku 'dra la snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ blos bslangs drung du snyan dar kha gang / bris mgon drung du snyan dar kha btags mthing khra/

dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ bla brang shar du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ gzur khang du sku 'dra rin po che mdze thod ma'i drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha btags/ gos bem ser po spus gtsang / dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ sa chen phug tu snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ phag mo phug tu snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ rje btsun gong ma'i phyi rten rnams la ras phan re re/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gser 'bum drung du snyan dar bkra shis rtags brgyad ma yug dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ 'khon sku 'bum du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ bde chen gling du snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ rje mus chen gyi sku brnyan drung du snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ rin chen sgang gtsug lag khang du snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ gzims khang 'brug ris mar snyan dar kha thags/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ rnam rgyal sku 'bum du ras phan che legs/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ g.yu thog mgon khang du snyan dar kha thags mthing khra/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ dge sding mgon khang du snyan dar kha thags mthing khra che legs/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ 'dra 'dri mgon khang du snyan dar bkra shis rtags brgyad ma/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ 'dra 'dri gtsug lag khang du snyan dar kha gang / dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ sgrol ma g.yu mkhar mo'i drung du snyan dar sman rtse do sbrel/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ lha khang bla brang du snyan dar bkra shis rtags brgyad ma/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ mgon khang nub tu yab rje bde gshegs kyi thugs dam ma 'cham mgon lcam dral drung du snyan dar gos sngon po rgya yig ma do sbrel/

sman rtse kha sbrel/ nged rang gis bzhengs pa'i lcam dral la gos nyis tshos ma kha sbrel/ bkra shis kha thags/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun// ༈ /sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha btags 'dom 'khor ma/ gos nag khra yug stag lpags gra sder ma nyams pa/ dkar me skyogs bcu/ zhal zas bcu/ sgo rum dpe khang du snyan dar bkra shis rtags brgyad ma/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ bla ma lha khang du sa paṇa gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma'i drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags che legs/ gos bam dmar po legs pa/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ theg chen rin po che'i sku brnyan la snyan dar gos ser po kha sbrel/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ gser khang du sa lo chen po dang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku la snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ gos lu hang kha gang lhag pa/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ dkar bdud mgon khang du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ kha thags mthing khra/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ tshom bar mgon khang du snyan dar kha thags mthing khra/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ 'cham mgon la snyan dar sman rtse kha/ nang sor myur mdzad las kyi mgon po'i drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ kha thags mthing khra che legs/ gos dmar rgyan gzhi kha sbrel/ rgya gar shang lang yag pa/ stag lpags gra sder ma nyams pa/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ shaka seng sku 'bum du/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ rdo rje 'chang la rnam rgyal zhal gzigs pa'i gzims chung sku 'dra la/ snyan dar gos ser po kha gang / dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ gzhon dbang sku 'bum du dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ grags bzang sku 'bum du dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ rin bzang sku 'bum du dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ shar sku 'bum du dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ sgang dkar bla brang du dkar me skyogs gsum/

zhal zas gsum/ bla brang nyi lder rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang gi sku gdung drung du snyan dar bkra shis rtags brgyad ma kha sbrel/ sbug chol skyon med cha/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ yang rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma'i drung du snyan dar/ sman rtse kha/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ bla brang dge 'phel du snyan dar bkra shis brtags brgyad ma/ sil snyan ma ṇi ma/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ dga' ldan du g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma'i drung du snyan dar sman rtse kha/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ mgon khang du snyan dar gos nag kha gang / dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ bla brang rdzong chung gi mgon khang gsar rnying gnyis su snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ kha thags mthing khra/ dkar me skyogs gsum re/ zhal zas gsum re/ bla brang brang mo cher sman rtse kha/ mgon khang du kha thags mthing khra/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ bla brang dus mchod du chos rje sa paṇa gyi sku brnyan drung du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ 'phrin las mgon po'i mgon khang du snyan dar gos dmar po rgyan gzhi ma kha gang / dkar me skyogs gsum re/ zhal zas gsum re/ lha khang rtse'i theg chen pho brang du/ sa chen/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang chen po rnams la snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse kha/ sog po kha thags/ dkar me skyogs bcu/ zhal zas bcu/ rtse'i mgon khang du snyan dar gos dmar po rgyan gzhi ma kha/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ lha khang mthil du thub dbang 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag la snyan dar gos ser po rgyan gzhi ma yug sne tshang dngos gtsang ba/ lha chen dpal 'bar la sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ nged rang gis gsar du bzhengs pa'i sa skya pa chen po'i sku brnyan la snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ yang nged rang gis bzhengs pa'i 'od dpag med kyi sku 'dra la snyan dar sman rtse kha gang / dkar me skyogs bco lnga/ zhal zas bco lnga/

bde mchog pho brang du sa chen gyi sku la snyan dar kha gang / nged rang gis bzhengs pa'i rje mus chen gyi sku brnyan la snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ sbug chol skyon med cha/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ gzims chung bde ba can du dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ mgon khang du snyan dar kha thags mthing khra/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ kha'u skyed lhas su gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ 'phags pa/ phyag na/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i rten gtso rnams la bkras thags/ sman rtse sogs kha re/ bla ma gong ma'i phyi rten/ mgon khang rnams su zhal zas rgyu rtsam bre gsum/ dkar rgyan mtshon pa/ dkar me nyag bcu bdun/ brag sgor snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ kha thags mthing khra/ gos nag yug rgya gar ral gri/ stag lpags gra sder ma nyams pa/ 'phru ma'i gtsug lag khang du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ mchod rten drung du snyan dar ras khra'i phan cha/ dkar me skyogs gsum/ zhal zas gsum/ bzhi thog rnam sras lha khang du snyan dar gos ser po kha do sbrel/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ bsam gling mgon khang du snyan dar bkra shis kha btags/ kha thags mthing khra/ gos za 'og yug stag lpags/ ral gri/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhal zas lnga/ byas 'gyur bla brang shar nub gnyis su snyan dar sman rtse kha re/ zhal zas rgyu rtsam pa bre gang / dkar rgyan mtshon pa/ dkar me rgyu mar nyag gsum/ nged rang gi gzim chung du 'phel gdung / shing mgon/ rdo mgon/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ rje mus chen/ thub pa 'od zer 'gyed/ lung bstan sgrol ma rnams la snyan dar bkra shis kha thags kha re re/ dkar me skyogs bcu/ zhal zas bcu/ gtsug lag gsar pa li ma lha khang rdo rje gdan du snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/ maṇḍal dngos gtsang ba stegs man 'ju dang bcas pa/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lngar snyan dar bkra shis kha thags/

maṇḍal spus gtsang stegs man 'ju dang bcas pa/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ dpe khang gsar pa chos mdzod chen mor maṇḍal spus gtsang ba man 'ju'i stegs bcas pa/ dkar me skyogs bdun/ zhal zas bdun/ phu ri mgon khang du snyan dar bkra shis kha btags/ dkar me skyogs lnga/ zhas zas lnga/ chos dung dkar po rgyang grags la dung dar bkra shis kha rtags 'dom 'khor ma/ rtse gdong bdag chen rin po che'i drung du bkra shis kha btags/ rten mthong che legs/ dkar yol rtsa ring / ling dom/ ras yug mkhan chen lho pa la/ bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse kha/ ling kha/ dkar yol rtsa ring / rgya spos/ ling dom/ ras yug mol bltams pa brgya dpon dge 'dun rin chen la/ btsun mo kha thags/ mtshon si kha/ sman rtse kha/ ling 'dom/ gos bem/ las chen pa dge 'phel bar/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ mtshon si kha/ las chen dus mchod par/ btsun mo/ sman rtse kha/ mtshon si/ gon ma/ bla ma rdo rje 'od zer la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ gon ma/ bsam yas rab byung bla ma la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ mtshon si kha/ gon ma/ chos 'khor lhun po'i bla ma la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ mtshon si gon ma/ phyag mdzod byams pa dpal 'byor la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ ras yug phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ ras yug ma chen kun dga' bzod pa la/ btsun mo/ spos reng / ras yug mchod dpon smon lam rin chen la/ btsun mo/ spos reng / ras yug dbu mdzad chos 'od zer la/ sman rtse kha/ spos reng / ras yug dbu mdzad byams pa rgya mtsho la mtshon si/ spos reng / gon chung / dbu mdzad kun dga' bsam gtan la/ mtshon si/ spos reng / gon chung / dbu mdzad ngag dbang rgyal mtshan la/ mtshon si/ spos rengs/ gon chung / dbu mdzad kun dga' sbyin pa la/ dar kha/ spos reng / gon chung / spyi chen la/ mthong lcags/ mtshon si/ ras yug dpon slob dgra 'u la/ btsun mo/ mtshon si kha/ sman rtse kha/ gon chung / lho pa'i 'bul dpon par/

btsun mo/ sman rtse/ dar kha/ gon chung / dpon slob rgya khag par/ btsun mo/ sman rtse kha/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ dpon slob mang thos la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ gon ma/ chos khrims dpon la/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ chos sde lho'i spyi 'bul la/ sman rtse kha/ dkar yol rtsa ring / rten thong / thong lcags/ rgya spos/ ling dom/ ras yug bde chen gling spyi 'bul la sman rtse tshon si/ mthong lcags/ ling dom/ ras yug bde chen gling gi dbu mdzad la/ mtshon si kha/ spos ring / ling dom/ bde chen gling chos chos khrims par/ mtshon si kha/ ling dom/ bde chen gling spyi par/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ban gtsang pa rnams la spyi 'bul/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ dkar yol rtsa ring / dar kha sbrel/ gos kha/ gon ma/ ras yug dkar po rgyang grags par mtshon si/ ling dom/ bzhi thog gnyer chen la/ btsun mo/ mtshon si/ kha sha tsaka sder/ ras yug gling ga drung chen sbrel por/ btsun mo/ sman rtse kha/ ras yug gdong dga' drung chen la/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ dge sding gnyer pa la mtshon si/ kha sha ling dom/ chos mdzad dge 'dun dpal 'byor la gong mtshungs/ drung chen byams pa dpal 'byor la/ sman rtse/ ras yug rma bya gnyer pa la mtshon si/ tsaka sder/ sa skya dpon yig la/ mtshon si/ thong lcags/ ras yug gtor las pa lnga la/ dar kha do/ kha sha/ ras yug dbyangs dpon bcu bzhi la/ btsun mo/ dar kha/ sman rtse/ spos rengs/ ras yug gdan sa bka' sgros spyi par/ mtshon si/ dkar yol/ thong lcags/ spun 'dab/ glang nga / ling dom/ ras yug gdan sa mdzod chen la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ dar kha/ ling dom/ bcu dpon gsum la/ mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder re re/ chos khrims gnyis dang dpon yig la/ dar kha/ ras yug stong dpon gsum la/ btsun mo/ dar kha/ ling dom/ drug bcu mthil pa'i spyi 'bul la/ dkar chen/ thong lcags/ tsaka sder/ spyi mchod par/ kha btags/ tsaka sder/ dbu rtse dkon gnyer la mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/

sgo rum dkon gnyer la/ mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/ nang so dkon gnyer la mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/ lha rtse'i dkon gnyer la/ mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/ bskyed lhas sku gnyer la mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/ mgon khang nub dkon gnyer la mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/ mgron gnyer gnyis la mtshon si/ spos reng / tsaka sder/ 'dren pa gnyis/ rtswa gnyer gnyis/ chang dpon/ chibs dpon/ ja dpon/ shing gnyer/ mi dpon bzhi rnams la tsaka sder re re/ nang zan gyi spyi 'bul la/ bkras dar/ sman rtse kha sbrel/ mtshon si/ ling kha/ thong lcags/ kha sha gla nga / dkar yol/ ling dom/ ras yug skya ho rnams la/ dar kha/ kha sha tsaka sder/ gtso thab dpon la/ mtshon si/ thong lcags/ tsaka sder/ mdzod pa'i shing gnyer dang chang ma la/ mtshon si/ tsaka sde re re/ lha gdong pa'i spyi 'bul la/ thong lcags/ tsaka sder/ mkhar po che'i spyi 'bul la/ de mtshungs/ sngags pa spyi 'bul la de mtshungs/ bzhi thog drung 'khor spyi 'bul la tshon si/ sgyer spen/ rin chen sgang spyi 'bul la/ mtshon si/ thong lcags/ khams pa las tshan spyi 'bul la/ mtshon si/ spun 'dab/ la shar pa'i spyi 'bul la/ mtshon si/ thong lcags/ spun 'dab/ la nub pa'i spyi 'bul/ mtshon si/ thong lcags/ grong rab bzhi la/ mtshon si/ thong lcags/ khro'i thab sgo bzhi la/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ dmag las pa rnams la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse kha/ spun 'dab/ tsaka sder/ ras yug skyed lhas bla brang par/ mtshon si/ spos reng / ras yug byas 'gyur sgrub dpon la/ mtshon si/ spos reng / ras yug sde pa rma bya par/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug yol gdong pa yum sras la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse dang kha sbrel/ ling dom/ ras yug mtsho sgo lcam sring la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ dar kha 'grel/ ling dom/ ras yug sde pa bkra shis sgang pa la bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug 'tsho byed mgon bsam la/ sman rtse/ bkras thags/ thong lcags/ ling dom/

ras yug 'tsho byed rin chen chos 'phel la btsun mo/ sman rtse/ ras yug shar chen par/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si do sbrel/ thong lcags/ ras yug 'dra 'dri bla mar/ btsun mo/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ dgon pa kha ba lhas bla mar/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ dar kha/ gon ma/ nang so rgya rgan par/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ras yug dpal ldan rtse par/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ras yug sgang chen dpon mor/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug srid gsum gnyer par/ mtshon si/ tsaka sder/ bsam yas mkhan tshangs par bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug ngam rings mkhan chen brang mo che'i gdan sa par/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug skyid tshal bla ma la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug dwags po grwa tshang bla ma la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug gur pa grwa tshang bla ma la bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug ri bo gru 'dzin bla ma la/ bkras thags/ sman tse/ ras yug ya ma'i bla ma la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug gling kha zur 'chad pa la/ mtshon si/ tsaka sder/ ble lung dbon po la mtshon si/ tsaka sder/ dgon pa rdzong dang / lung chung / ble lung spyi pa gsum la/ mtshon si/ tsaka sder/ yangs pa can gyi bka' chen la/ btsun mo/ ling dom/ yangs can dkar khra gnyis kyi grwa pa lnga la/ mtshon si/ tsaka sder/ btsun mo/ lha sa nas mchod yon mi sna mdu lung par/ bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si do sbrel/ ling dom/ ras yug bkra shis lhun po nas mi sna la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gos kha/ ling dom/ ras yug brag dmar chos sde'i drung chen la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gon ma/ ras yug bu khrid/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug rgyal rtse nas bla ma'i drung la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug byang nas bdag po bla ma'i drung la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug snye mo nas khri lcam yum sras la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug mdar pa'i lcam yum sras la/

bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ na ring spyi pa la/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ drung yig nyi shar la btsun mo/ tsaka sder/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi mi snar/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ gon ma/ ras yug thar rtse pa'i drung chen la/ sman rtse/ gon ma/ skyid tshal 'og gi che sgres gnyis la/ sman rtse/ gon ma/ 'bras yul skyid tshal drung chen la sman rtse/ gon ma/ mdar bsam 'grub par bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras yug spel bar/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras yug rgyal rtse rje btsun ma mched la/ btsun mo/ sman rtse/ ras yug yag chos bla spyi la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras yug sgrol ma phug par/ bkra shis kha thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras yug rin chen gling spyi par/ mtshon/ ling dom/ phu sum spyi pa rnams la/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ thub bstan rnam rgyal mi snar bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ras yug sgyi chu dbon por/ btsun mo/ ling shog gser mdog can gyi mi snar/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ ling dom/ ras yug dgra lha dbon po/ za mo/ zhe dgon/ lu phu sogs kyi spyi pa mi sna ngo re yod pa la/ mtshon si/ tsaka sder re re/ smon 'gro ba'i mi sna yar 'phel bkra shis la/ bkras thags/ sman rtse/ mtshon si/ ling dom/ ras yug rnams dang / de ltar nyi ma dang po tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin tshogs chen la nas 'bo re ma gsang yum gyis brgyab pa'i/ phyogs kyi mi sna rnams la tshogs skal/ mchod yon mi sna la nas khal gcig bkra shis lhun po/ snye mo khri lcam/ byang pa bdag po/ rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung / ngam ring mkhan chen/ brgya tsho dpon rnams la bre bcu re/ las chen gnyis/ chos 'khor lhun po'i bla ma/ rtse gdong mi sna/ ngor pa/ rab byung bla ma/ mkhan tshan pa/ dwags po grwa tshang bla ma/ skyid tshal bla ma/ gur pa bla ma/ ri bo gru 'dzin bla ma/ kha ba lhas bla ma/ rgyas bla ma/ ya ma zur 'chad pa/ dpon slob dgra'u/ khams pa'i bla chen gsum/ lho'i bla ma gsar rnying gnyis/

bla ma rdo rje 'od zer/ rta nag sgrol ma/ mtsho sgo lcam sring / yol gdong yum sras/ dpal rtse ba/ rgya rgan pa/ rang byon pa/ snye mo ba'i lcam gnyis/ mdar pa'i lcam/ mdar bsam 'grub pa/ rgyal rtse ba'i lcam gnyis/ yag chos bla ma/ chos rje rig 'dzin/ bu khrid/ shar chen pa rnams la bre drug re/ che 'dren pa byin dang / mchod yon gyi mi sna'i g.yog drag pa gcig snye mo ba'i mgron gnyer dang mchod gnas/ skyed tshal 'og gi gnyer pa gnyis/ 'bras yul skyed tshal mi sna/ chos sde brag dmar ba'i mi sna/ gser mdog can pa'i mi sna/ dge 'phel che sgres pa/ brang chen che sgres pa/ sgang chen chos ldan/ yangs can pa'i mi sna drug zur chad dbon po/ ble lung dbon po/ dgra lha dbon po/ 'tsho byed rin chen chos 'phel/ lung chung / dgon pa rdzong / za mo/ zhe dgon rnams kyi spyi pa dang gzhan mi sna ngo re yod pa rnams la nas bre bzhi re/ nyi ma gnyis pa tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin 'di kha rang nas nas 'bo re tshogs chen la brgyab pa'i tshogs skal mi sna rnams la gong mtshungs// ༈ /nyi ma gsum pa tshes bco lnga dngos gzhi'i nyin tshogs pa skya ser kun la nas 'bo rgyag mar rgyar sum cha ma re phyogs kyi mi sna sogs dga' ston 'bul mi rnams la/ thog mar mchod yon mi sna la mar nyag bdun/ nas khal gsum/ rgyal rtse nas bla ma'i drung la mar nyag lnga/ nas khal gnyis/ byang nas bdag po bla ma'i drung dang / bkra shis lhun po'i mi sna la gong / snye mo nas khri lcam yum sras gsum la mar nyag bcu/ nas khal gsum/ mdar lcam la mar nyag gsum/ nas bre bco lnga/ mtsho sgo lcam sring la mar nyag lnga/ nas bre bco lnga/ yol gdong nas yum sras la/ mar nyag lnga/ nas bre bco lnga/ sman grong nas rje btsun ma gnyis la gong mtshungs/ nang so rgya rgan pa/ rtse gdong mi sna/ e waṃ drung chen rnams la mar nyag phyed dang gsum/ nas bre bcu/ dpon sa bu khrid la mar nyag do/
