nas bre bdun/ ngam ring mkhan chen la mar nyag lnga/ nas khal phyed dang gnyis/ skyed tshal bla ma/ gru 'dzin bla ma/ gur pa bla ma/ dwags po bla ma/ kha ba lhas bla ma/ ya ma zur 'chad pa/ rgyas bla ma/ rab byung bla ma/ bla ma kun dga' chos bzang / lho'i bla ma gsar rnying gnyis/ khams pa'i bla chen gsum la mar nyag gsum/ nas bre bcu/ mkhan tshangs par gong mtshungs/ yangs pa can pa'i mi sna drug snye mo ba'i mchod gnas dang mgron gnyer/ ble lung / lung chung / dgon pa rdzong / za mo ba/ dge sding gnyer pa/ gling kha drung chen gsum/ gdong kha drung chen/ srid gsum gnyer pa/ ding ri gnyer pa/ rma bya gnyer pa/ thar rtse drung chen/ 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi mi sna/ gser mdog can mi sna/ chos sde brag dmar ba'i mi sna/ gnyer pa rdor bkras/ dge 'phel che sgres pa/ skyed tshal 'og gi gnyer pa gnyis/ mchod yon mi sna'i g.yog drag pa gcig rnams la nang zan lugs/ spel ba/ rgya mtsho ba/ sgrol ma phug pa/ smon 'gro nas mi sna yar 'phel bkra shis rnams la mar nyag gsum re/ nas bre bcu re/ 'tsho byed rin chen chos 'phel la mar nyag gsum/ nas khal gnyis/ drung yig nyi shar bar mar nyag do/ nas khal gcig bkra shis sgang pa dang / rma bya ba la mar nyag do re nas bre bco lnga re/ na ring spyi pa/ yag chos spyi pa/ zhe dgon spyi pa rnams la nang gzan lugs/ rting skyes mi sna la mar nyag gsum/ nas bre bco lnga/ de ltar gong gi 'bul ba gda' rnams rdzogs mtshams/ brgya dpon sgo rum pa dge 'dun rin chen gyis langs nas gso ba gyon te mol ba rgyas pa btang / khro khang steng nas bsngo rten rnams gsar te/ dgu tshan dang po la bkra shis kha btags brgyad ma yug rten thong che legs/ tshe dpag med rgya nag ma/ gser srang gsum/ bla bre khyad 'phags/ bum gdan ma dngos gtsang ba/ ding dpon sngo khra yug nang bcas/ spu ja 'khor drug ma/ dkar yug rnams/ dgu tshan gnyis pa la bkra shis kha thags 'dom 'khor ma/

rten khebs bzang sgrigs che legs/ zhal dkar 'dra shel tshe ring ma/ gos yug ser po ri mo khyad du thon pa nang bcas/ bla bre spus gtsang / gos ding dpon sngo khra spus gtsang ba nang bcas/ rgya gos/ gon ma/ dkar yug dgu tshan gsum pa la/ bkra shis kha btags kha bzhi sbrel/ rten khebs che legs/ tshe lha rnam rgyal gyi sku/ bla bre bkra shis rtags brgyad ma/ dngul jus 'brug ris ma khyad 'phags/ bkras thags kyi yol ba/ ding dpon sngo khra yug nang bcas/ gon ma/ dkar yug sne tshang rnams khri steng slebs bstun khri chen mo'i lho nub zur du gdan dmar bting la/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gis phyag gsum btsal nas bsngo rten rnams phul rjes/ nged rang gis 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis gang zin gyi sgo nas bsngo ba'i yon bshad rgyas pa dang bcas/ legs byas phun sum tshogs pa 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba che phra thams cad 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rnam dag dga' mgu yi rang ba'i sgo nas rgyas par bgyis shing / de skabs bkra shis nyin mo bde legs ma tshugs pa dang / btso thabs pas 'brang rgyas kyi 'khris su langs nas zhwa g.yug cing ki sgra rgyag de mthun tshogs pa thams cad kyis zhwa g.yug cing ki sgra mdzad/ de bzhin dge 'dun thams cad kyis mdzad dgos pa'i tshogs skad chos sde lho'i chos khrims las thog pas langs nas/ ja gsum ka'i gnyis pa phyogs gcig sgril ba mchod grub mtshams gtong / de nas bkra shis grub pa dang sngar bzhin bca' sgrigs ngos/ nged rang yab sras 'khor dang bcas pa bzhi thog tu phebs/ de mtshams tshogs pa byin 'phrang zhur byas skam 'gyed rnams rim pas gtong / 'dir skabs kyi 'brangs rgyas ni tshogs kyi dbus su gtso thabs pa'i lag len byas/ spag po rtsigs pa'i steng du dar dkar ser gang rung gi mda' dar btsugs pa'i 'brangs rgyas mchod gtor mar gyi nyi zlas brgyan pa gzhong pa'i nang du bzhag pa la chab bran te/

tshogs dpon su yin gyis khri khar phebs 'phral/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs la/ a ka ro'i sngags kyis chos srung gzhi bdag rnams la phul zhing dngos nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams su bde skyid rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung ba'i 'phrin las 'chol ba yin// ༈ /spyi 'gyed la mi re la bre do ma thob rtsis kyi/ thog mar bkra shis kha btags kyi yol ba la nas khal lnga bcu/ mi grangs lnga brgya/ dkar yol 'chag med shub bcas bcu khres la/ nas khal nyi shu/ mi nyis brgya/ yang 'chag yod med 'dres pa bcu khres la nas khal bco lnga/ mi grangs phyed dang nyis brgya/ ting bshags cha drug la nas khal gsum/ mi sum cu/ ting shags shel ba cha bcu la nas khal bzhi/ mi bzhi bcu/ yang ting shags cha brgyad la nas khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ rag 'gag bzhi brgya dang dgu la nas khal nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ rag 'gag bcu gres la nas khal lnga/ mi lnga bcu re brtsis pa'i mi grangs stong phrag gnyis dang phyed dang lnga brgya/ dril bu rab lnga la nas khal re bre drug re/ mi bcu gsum re brtsis pa'i mi grangs drug cu re lnga/ dril bu 'bring lnga la nas khal lnga mi lnga bcu/ dril bu shel ba bcu la bre bcu drug re/ mi brgyad re brtsis pa'i khal brgyad la mi brgyad bcu/ dril chung gnyis la khal gcig bre drug mi bcu gsum/ gtor cha la khal gcig bre drug mi bcu gsum/ yang gtor cha gcig la khal gcig mi bcu/ g.yas shag rab gnyis la khal gcig bre bcu gnyis/ mi bcu drug yang g.yas shag gnyis la khal gcig bre brgyad/ mi bcu bzhi/ yang g.yas shag gnyis la khal gcig bre bzhi/ mi bcu gnyis/ yang g.yas shag gnyis la bre drug mi gsum/ dang po gcig la nas khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang dang po gcig la khal gcig bre drug mi bcu gsum/ yang dang po gser shog ma gnyis la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/

rmog rab gcig la nas khal phyed dang gsum/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yang gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang gcig la khal phyed dang gsum/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yang gcig la khal gnyis mi nyi shu/ yang gcig la khal phyed dang gsum/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yang gcig la khal gcig bre bzhi mi bcu gnyis/ yang gcig la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ yang gcig la khal gcig bre drug mi bcu gsum/ yang rmog gnyis la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang gnyis la khal gnyis bre bcu gnyis/ mi nyi shu rtsa drug yang rmog gnyis la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ yang rmog bzhi la khal bzhi/ mi bzhi bcu/ yang rmog gcig la bre bcu bzhi/ mi bdun/ rmog gzhol ma gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ khro che ba la khal gsum/ mi sum cu/ khro gsum la khal drug mi drug cu/ yang gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ khro chung la khal gcig mi bcu/ ka to ra gsum la khal bzhi bre bzhi/ mi bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ ka to ra gnyis la khal phyed dang gsum/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yang gnyis la khal gnyis bre bzhi/ mi nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ yang ka to ra la khal gsum bre bcu gnyis/ mi sum cu so drug zangs zer bzhi la khal bcu gcig bre bcu bzhi/ mi brgya dang bcu bdun/ yang gsum la khal drug bre bcu gnyis/ mi drug cu re drug yang gcig la khal gnyis bre do/ mi nyi shu rtsa gcig yang zangs zer gsum la khal drug mi drug cu/ yang che chung gnyis la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ zangs rkyen gcig la khal gcig bre bcu drug mi bco brgyad/ zangs zer gnyis la khal gsum bre brgyad/ mi so bzhi/ zangs zer gcig la khal gcig mi bcu/ zangs stibs gsum la khal drug mi drug cu/ ljon krongs la khal gcig bre bcu gnyis/ mi bcu drug ljon krong shel ba la bre bcu drug mi brgyad/ zangs 'khor gcig la khal gsum/

mi sum cu/ yang zangs 'khor gcig la khal phyed dang gsum/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yang gcig la khal gcig bre bcu drug mi bco brgyad/ yang gcig la khal gcig bre bcu drug mi bco brgyad/ stabs li gcig la khal gcig bre do/ mi bcu gcig zangs 'khor la khal gnyis bre bzhi/ mi nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ zangs chung la bre bcu drug mi brgyad/ lcags sgyid che ba la khal gnyis bre bcu bzhi/ mi nyi shu rtsa bdun/ lcags sgyid 'bring pa gsum la khal phyed dang brgyad/ mi bdun cu don lnga/ lcags sgyid gsum la khal drug mi drug cu/ yang lcags sgyid chung ba la khal gcig bre drug mi bcu gsum/ lcags sgyid chung ngu gnyis la bre bcu/ mi lnga/ zangs che ba la khal bcu/ mi brgya/ glo zangs la khal bcu gcig mi brgya dang bcu/ rongs zangs la khal lnga/ mi lnga bcu/ yang zangs gcig la khal brgyad/ mi brgyad cu/ yang zangs gcig la khal bcu gnyis/ mi brgya dang nyi shu/ zangs 'khor gcig la khal bzhi/ mi bzhi bcu/ yang zangs gcig la khal drug mi drug cu/ zangs shu gnyis la khal bco brgyad/ mi brgya dang brgyad cu/ yang zangs shu shel ba la khal brgyad/ mi brgyad cu/ zangs sbug khebs bcas la khal nyi shu/ mi nyis brgya/ zangs gcig la khal bzhi/ mi bzhi bcu/ lcags sgyid che ba gnyis la khal bcu/ mi brgya/ lcags sgyid chung ngu la khal gcig mi bcu bzhi/ khrab gsum la khal bzhi bcu/ mi bzhi brgya/ khrab gnyis la khal bcu drug mi brgya dang drug cu/ yang rab gnyis la khal bco brgyad/ mi brgya dang brgyad cu/ khrab gcig la khal drug mi drug cu/ mdun khrab la khal lnga/ mi lnga bcu/ yang mdun khrab la khal gsum/ mi sum cu/ yang mdun khrab la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ yang stod 'grel la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ yang mdun khrab la bre bcu/ mi lnga/ yang rkang khrab la bre bcu gnyis/ mi drug lcags 'bag gsum la khal gnyis bre bcu drug mi nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lcags zhib la khal bzhi bcu/ mi bzhi brgya/

lcang zhib gcig la khal bco lnga/ mi phyed dang nyis brgya/ yang lcags zhib gcig la khal nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mi phyed dang sum brgya/ yang lcags zhib gcig la khal sum cu so lnga/ mi phyed dang bzhi brgya/ lcags gzhib la khal nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mi phyed dang sum brgya/ yang lcags zhib gcig la khal bcu/ mi brgya/ kag chung gcig la bre bcu drug mi brgyad/ lcags sgyid bzhi la khal bcu dang bre bzhi/ mi brgya dang gnyis/ rmog drug la khal bcu dang bre bcu/ mi brgya dang lnga/ zangs shu gcig la khal dgu/ mi dgu bcu/ snam bu brgya la nas khal phyed dang nyis brgya/ mi stong phrag phyed dang gnyis/ lcags 'bag gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ dkar yol lnga la khal drug mi drug cu/ dkar yol chag yod bdun la khal gcig bre brgyad/ mi bcu bzhi/ dgas cham ser shog la khal gcig bre drug mi bcu gsum/ cham shel ba la bre bcu drug mi brgyad/ sgam la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ rta chas gsar chas dngul tshags yag pa la khal drug cu/ mi drug brgya/ nya phyis kyi sga skor bca' tshang la khal bdun cu/ mi bdun brgya/ gser dngul ra ma lugs gsar chas la khal sum cu/ mi sum brgya/ rta chas dung chas bca' tshang la khal lnga/ mi lnga bcu/ yang dung chas shel ba la khal phyed dang gsum ste dung chas gnyis la/ mi lnga bcu/ hor sga dngul tshags ma yag pa la khal bcu drug mi brgya dang drug hor sga sha ru ma la khal lnga/ mi lnga bcu/ yang sga gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang hor sga gcig la khal gsum/ mi sum cu/ rmog gcig la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ yang rmog gcig la bre bcu bzhi/ mi bdun/ zangs gcig la khal drug mi drug bcu/ gri dga' lod 'dres pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ khal sum cu so dgu bre bzhi/ mi sum brgya dang dgu cu go gnyis/ kha sha rab gri nyi shu la nas khal bcu gnyis/ mi brgya dang nyi shu/ shel ba nyi shu la khal brgyad/ mi brgyad cu/

ra ko lnga la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ stod gos bzhi la khal gcig bre bzhi/ mi bcu gnyis/ gzan gcig la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ lcam sngon la khal gcig bre bcu drug mi bco brgyad/ sbyar bem la khal gsum/ mi sum cu/ spem chung la bre bzhi/ mi gnyis/ smad g.yogs la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ rngul len la bre do mi gcig grum rtse dga' lod 'dres pa gsum la khal lnga bre bzhi/ mi lnga bcu nga gnyis te 'di yan la nas khal stong phrag gcig dang / sum brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bre drug khyem sum cu la nas khal sum cu so drug mi sum brgya dang drug cu/ krong phor pa dang bcas par khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ lag rtse gsum la bre bcu gnyis/ mi drug ting sgyer ma lnga/ sgong shar ma gnyis la bre bcu bzhi/ mi bdun/ mchod ong gcig la bre do/ mi gcig rdor dril sbrags par bre bcu drug mi brgyad/ mdo cha/ ting shags/ ga'u sogs la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ rag chas gnyis la khal phyed dang gsum/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dkar yol bdun la khal gcig bre brgyad/ mi bcu bzhi/ g.yas shag yag pa la khal gcig mi bcu/ g.yas shag gsum la khal gnyis bre brgyad/ mi nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ g.yas shag gnyis la bre bzhi/ mi gnyis/ zor ba yag pa gnyis la bre bcu drug mi brgyad/ zor ba 'bring lnga la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ zor ba gnyis la bre brgyad/ mi bzhi/ rmog rab 'bring dgu la nas khal bcu bzhi dang bre drug mi brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe gsum/ yang rag 'gag drug cu la nas khal sum cu/ mi sum brgya/ gri rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi bcu bdun la/ nas khal nyi shu phyed dang rtsa bzhi/ mi nyis brgya dang sum cu so lnga/ khrab gnyis la khal nyi shu/ mi nyis brgya/ yang khrab gnyis la khal bcu bzhi/ mi brgya dang bzhi bcu/ khrab gcig la khal drug mi drug cu/ zangs 'khor la khal gcig mi bcu/ ga'u la bre bzhi/ mi gnyis/ dung chas cha tshang la khal gsum/ mi sum cu/

stod thung pho gzugs la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ yang stod thung la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu/ gzan dkar po la khal gsum/ mi sum cu/ gzan snam pa bzhi la bre bcu/ mi lnga/ dar bkras thags dkar chen sogs nyi shu phon bzhi la nas khal nyi shu/ mi nyis brgya/ sman rtse nyi shu phon gnyis la nas khal bcu gcig mi brgya dang bcu/ dar phon nyi shu phon nyi shu rtsa gnyis la/ nas khal bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ mi bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu/ snam bu bcu khres gnyis la khal sum cu/ mi sum brgya/ snam bu lnga bcu la nas khal bdun bcu don lnga/ mi bdun brgya dang lnga bcu/ zan gro mo la khal phyed dang gnyis/ mi bco lnga/ grum rtse bzhi la nas khal lnga bre bcu drug mi lnga bcu nga brgyad/ dung chas la bre brgyad/ mi bzhi/ rta gnyis la nas khal sum cu so bzhi/ mi sum brgya dang bzhi bcu/ ka phyi yug sne tshang la khal gnyis/ mi nyi shu ste yongs bsdoms nas khal stong phrag gcig dang bdun brgya sum cu so bdun/ mi khri tsho gcig stong phrag bdun/ sum brgya/ bdun bcu rnams byung zhing / de lta bu'i tho rags rim btab pa 'di rnams ni bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur nas/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug che 'don gyi dga' ston sgrub cing bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar ba 'bad med lhun grub tu byung ba'i tshul rnams mdo tsam brjod pa yin la/ slar che 'don mdzad pa rnams 'di la gzhi gdung dgos rgyu yin// ༈ /gzhan yang nged rang gi zhal ngo rnams kyi sku rim du dmigs nas gro 'gyed sgrub pa rnams khri 'don 'bul ba dang / thub pa dgongs gsal gnang ba nyi ma gsum gyi grangs tshad gnang ba rnams mi dgos/ mdo bskul ba dang / maṇḍal 'bul ba bzhag tshogs dpon khri khar phebs kyang bla dung gtong ba/ gral chos 'gyed pa sogs 'dra/ de nas tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis chos brjod kyi rim pa sku rim gang 'gro byed/

tshogs dpon la bsngo rten 'os babs 'bul/ gzhan rnam gzhag tshang ma 'dra/ yang sde dpon rigs che ba rnams kyi sku rim sgrub na/ mo la ba'i gzhung ma'i khri chung byang ma'i steng nas mol la gtong ba tsam ma gtogs/ sku rim chos brjod bskul ba sogs tshang ma gong dang 'dra// ༈ /gnyis pa bla ma gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs dang / sde dpon rigs sogs kyi gshin po'i don du 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyis sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po sgrub pa ni/ gong sku rim gyi skabs bzhin nyin gang ma gzhir bzhag la/ snga dro shin tu snga bar dge 'dun pa khe rkyang 'du khang gang yin du tshogs pas/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i sgrub mchod yongs su rdzogs pa gnang ba'i dril thogs bshom cha yod pa/ der rjes mang ja'i tshogs dung btang ba nas bsngo bas rgyas 'debs/ 'gyed gtong ba sogs gong dang 'dra/ chos spyod bskul dus bzang spyod/ ltung bshags sogs skabs thob dang bstun nas byed/ gang zag gzhung ma blo spangs che ba'i gshin gson gyi rim gro dge rtsa la dmigs gro bar sgrub pa byung na 'bul bar gda' dang / 'gyed 'grub na rab/ ma grub na nas mar rkyang pa gtong ba dang / mang ja/ nyung ja/ bsngo rten/ dung dar/ khro dar/ mon chung pu tra dang / a ma rho skyong ma'i gsol mchod sogs gong bzhin dgos/ mo dar 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i gang 'byor/ mo la yang khri chung lho ma'i steng nas kha khri chen la bltas nas gtong / gzhan dgos cha thams cad gong dang 'dra/ yang gang zag gzhung ma'i rim gro yin na/ dril thogs kun rig mi dgos/ dge rtsa yin na snga dro dril thogs bre re ma sogs 'byor pa dang bstun/ mar bzhi cha las chung thabs med/ gro bar gyi mar nas kyang de dang 'dra/ 'gyed dang 'bul ba gda' ma bshom na bsngo rten sogs gong du bsdus pa brjod pa bzhin bya/

gzhan mar gtub sogs gang dgos 'byor bshom dang bstun pa'i che chung ma gtogs dpe 'dra tshang ma yongs rdzogs dgos rgyu yin/ de dag gis ni nged rang sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams khri 'don mdzad pa'i tshul zhar byung dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag rnams bstan zin nas/ da ni bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched kyi mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i rnam gzhag rgya chen po mdzad dus/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis de skabs kyi bca' sgrigs kyi zhal bkod ji snyed gnang ba rnams/ bzhi thog gnyer khang gi deb chen du 'debs par mdzad pa bzhin/ nged rang sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud da lta yod pa dang / ma 'ongs pa 'byon 'gyur rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ rang nyid dad pa'i dbang gis sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung gi zur ma nyams pa deb chen rin chen gter mdzod las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin brjod par bya ste/ de yang ji skad du/ sa pho stag lo mgo zla ba'i yar tshes dus bzang po sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dus mchod tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin dgun chos tshugs pa mdzad/ zhag lnga'i bar khri thog pa rgan pa bsod nams dbang pos mdo rgyud kyi po ti brgya dang sum cu so gnyis/ khri thog pa gzhon pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bka' chen bco brgyad/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud/ dam chos padma dkar po dang bcas pa rnams la bshad pa dang sbyor ba mtha' 'khyongs par mdzad pa sogs kyi dgos cha'i thad/ chos dung byung nas tshogs su phebs mtshams/ zhogs ja nyung ja nas khri chen steng du gang yod/ khri chung bskor du chos sde lho byang gi mkhan po gnyis/ las chen gnyis/ khri thog pa gnyis kyi phyag g.yog pa bzhi/ bshad pa'i phyag phyi ba gzhu lung rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dkon khang pa chos rgyal mtshan/ dbu gdugs 'dzin mkhan gsum/ chos sde lho byang gi spyi chen gnyis/

dbu mdzad gnyis/ chos khrims pa gnyis/ sde spyi'i chos khrims pa gnyis/ sa skya dpon yig khro gnyer/ gtso thabs pa/ skya ho gsum/ las chung rnams la 'dren/ de rjes mang ja snga mas tsha rting ma go chod/ ja rgod bzhes tshar mtshams zhal ngo dpon slob rnams mtshams khang du gdan bzhes la phebs/ gzhan mkhan chen las chen sogs kyis gtso mdzad 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gdan non gyi dgos cha/ mkhan chen lho byang / las chen gnyis la zhib bre re/ zhal 'gro zhib chen lcags zer/ mkhan chen la bur thud gnyis re/ skya thud gnyis re/ mar nyag gsum re/ las chen gnyis la bur thud re/ skya thud gnyis/ mar nyag do re/ bde chen gling gi dbu mdzad spyi chen/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ spyi chen/ chos khrims dpon/ ban gtsang pa'i 'gan khur rnag pa gcig dbu mdzad 'di dbyangs dpon yin/ mchod dpon/ dkar po rgyang grags pa/ khri gnyer/ gtso thabs pa/ sde spyi'i chos khrims rgan pa/ sa skya dpon yig rnams la thud zhogs chen re dang phyed gras re/ gzhan che 'dren dkyus ma thob pa dbyangs dpon bcu bzhi/ ban gtsang pa gzhon pa gang yod/ dus mdos kyi gtor las rnams/ bde chen gling gi spyi pa gzhon/ chos khrims pa/ sgo ra ba/ sde spyi'i chos khrims gzhon pa/ chos 'khor lhun po ba'i spyi chos gsum rnams la thud kha gras re/ mar gsum cha re/ tshogs byin la mar gsum cha re/ thud bre thud re la drug bcu re bzhi bcos pa re/ che 'dren pa sogs tshang ma la zhib bre re/ gdan gzhes thog tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis gong bstod dang / rab mdzes ma/ sangs rgyas rjes dran rnams bskul/ gdan bzhes grol mtshams bstan pa'i rnam gzhag pa dpon slob rnams phebs gdong / rgyud ja nas zhogs ja bzhin 'dren/ mang ja rting mas gro ja'i go chod byed/ dgong ja rgyud ja dang 'dra/ mang ja la ja nyag bcu bzhi re/ nyung ja rnams la nyag re dkar ba re/

rdor phyed dang gsum bskor/ tshwa 'o ma 'os babs/ nyi ma lnga'i gsol ba'i rgyu song mar khal bdun cu don gcig nyag bco lnga/ chur ba bre bco lnga/ grol nyin dang spyi skyur gyi gsol ba la/ byin la nyag phyed ma/ thud stag drug cu re bzhi ma/ mkhan rin po che la gsol thud zhogs ma drug mar nyag lnga/ las chen gnyis la mar nyag gsum re/ thud zhogs gsum re/ mkhan chen lho pa la thud zhogs bzhi/ mar nyag bzhi/ tshes bcu'i snga dro gangs la nyi rtse la chos dung yong ba mdzad/ de 'phral yab sras rnams tshogs su phebs/ de nyin nyung ja rgyal rtse nas zhus pa'i steng 'bul ba byung pa la/ bkra shis kha thags/ dngul phor/ rten khebs/ gos phyi dmar po 'jam sang yug nang sman rtse skya khra yug 'bras thang / lcags dos gcig spen 'dab bub/ ling dom/ rta gcig stag lpags/ grum rtse/ ras dkar yug rnams byung / nyung ja gnyis pa song rjes/ zhing gnas kyi mang ja/ de nas zhing nas kyis nyung ja zhus pa'i thog 'bul ba byung ba la/ bkra shis kha thags/ sgrol ma'i sku/ rten khebs/ dngul phor/ gos bzang kha skabs skabs la gser yod pa yug nang mtshon si ljang khu yug gos chen ljang khu 'jam sang gi rgya gos/ ras khra/ spen 'dab bub/ ling dom/ sog byus kyi yol ba/ ras dkar yug grum rtse/ rta/ sku 'bum pas gsol ja tib rgyugs thog dar kha do/ ras sna bzhi/ de nas rgyud ja song rjes sde pa rang gi mang ja/ de'i rjes su dgong ja/ tshes bco lnga'i snga dro nyung ja gzims chung pas zhus te/ kha thags/ dkar yol/ spos chag dar yug rtse ja sdum/ kha sha ling dom/ ras yug rgod ma/ der rjes ngor nas mang ja zhus thog bkra shis kha thags/ dkar yol sngo khra/ ja bsigs/ dar yug sman rtse gnyis/ rten khebs/ theg chen dril bu shub bcas/ spos bzhi bcu khres/ ling dom/ ras dkar yug mkhan rin po che byang pas/ kha thags/ dar yug dmar po/ dkar yol/ spos chag gos dmar po kha gang / mtshon si kha 'brel/

spen 'dab bub/ kha sha ras yug gsum/ ling dom bzhi/ dkon khang pas gsol ja tib rgyugs thog kha thags/ spos chag kha thags nag khra gcig zangs tib legs pa/ ka to ra/ dkar yol/ gon ma gcig ras yug gnyis/ dwags po ba dang / srang gzhug pas gsol ja tib rgyugs thog dwags po bas kha thags/ dkar yol/ ther ma gsum bub/ ling dom/ srang gzhug pas dar kha gang / ling dom/ ras yug gnas dge ba dang nub pa gnyis kyis gsol ja tib rgyugs thog gnas dge bas kha thags/ snam bu ya gcig ras sna gnyis/ nub pa bas kha thags/ dkar yol/ ling dom/ ras yug zil gnon pas/ kha btags/ 'bras btang / ling dom/ ras yug de nas rgyud ja chos 'khor lhun po bas zhus steng / chos rje ngag dbang pas/ kha thags/ dkar yol/ spos bcu khres/ zangs 'khor/ bur btang / ling dom/ ras yug gdan sa pa rang gis kha thags/ zangs 'khor/ bur btang / spos chag dgong mo'i mang ja sman grong pas/ kha thags/ rta/ ras yug tshes bcu drug gi snga dro nyung ja dang mang ja gnyis gdong dga' nas zhus shing / tshogs pa la nas 'gyed bre re ma dang / nyung ja'i thog bkra shis kha thags/ gser srang phyed/ rgya dril rtse lnga ma shub bcas/ gos chen/ dur kha 'jam sang yug nang dar mtshon pa'i sngon po yug sman rtse'i yol ba/ bur btang gcig ling dom/ ras yug rta/ de rjes thugs rje tshon si kha do sbrel gcig rgya kar yu thung gcig ling dom gnyis/ spen thog gnyis/ ras yug gnyis/ ther ma legs pa gsum bub/ sa chos kyi tshon si kha gang / ling dom/ ras yug 'phrang pa dang a lod gnyis kyis gsol ja tib rgyugs thogs/ 'phrang pas dar kha gang / dngul phor/ ling dom/ a lod kyis dar kha gang / gon ma gnyis/ dkar yol gcig ras yug skya spe bas dar kha gang / dkar sha khog gcig ras yug bya spe bas kha thags/ ghiṃ tshon pa/ khre sder ma do/ gon ma gcig gru brku bas dar kha gang / dkar yol gcig ras yug rgyud ja song rjes/ dgong mo'i mang ja sde pa rang gis gnang /

de nas dgong ja/ tshes bcu bdun gyi snga dro/ nyung ja gzim skyid pas zhus thog kha thags dkar po/ spos bcu khres/ gsol 'ching rgya tshos ma shin tu dngos gtsang zhing gos chen sna tshogs kyi rgyan legs pa dang bcas pa/ gos ljang gu ri mo can kha sbrel/ dar yug tshon si sngon po'i rgya gos/ dkar yol/ spen 'dab bub/ snam dkar nyis bub/ ling dom/ ras yug chos sde lho'i mkhan chen gyis kha thags/ dkar yol/ spos bcu khres/ ras yug ling dom/ de nas mang ja chos sde lho'i spyi pas zhus thog kha thags dkar po/ dar yug sman rtse ser khra gcig dar skyer kha yug gcig yang dar yug sngon po gcig zangs 'khor gcig lcags sgyid/ mar tshugs che chung gsum/ spos bzhi bcu khres/ ther ma gsum bub gnyis/ ling dom/ ras yug yang chos sde byang pa'i spyi pas/ kha thags/ dar yug dkar yol/ zangs 'khor gcig spos chag ther ma gsum bub gcig ling dom/ ras yug de nas rgyud ja nang zan tshos zhus steng / dar kha gang / dngul phor/ dar yug sman rtse kha bzhi sbrel/ yang dar kha 'khyar kha bzhi/ snam dkar lnga/ ling dom gsum/ ras dkar yug gnyis/ cha zhabs spyi'i kha thags/ dkar yol/ dar yug yang dar kha lnga sbrel/ ling dom dga' ba gnyis/ sga khang ma gnyis/ kha sha gcig ras yug lo pa bas dar kha gang / ling dom/ ras yug sgo mo che pas kha thags/ ling dom/ ras yug bcu dpon mdzod pa bas dar kha gang / mar krog sga khang ma gcig kun dga' rab rgyas kyis kyang de mtshungs gcig sngags pa rnams kyis dar kha gang / sga khang ma gcig grog kha ba rang gis kha thags gcig dang / ras yug gcig bon po rnams kyis/ kha thags gcig mar krog gsum/ gon ma/ gnyan pas tshon si kha sbrel/ ras yug las chen gnyis kyis gsol ja thog kha thags/ sku gcig rdzogs chen gyi skor gyi po ti gcig rnam rgyal mchod rten/ ling dom/ brgya dpon gnyis kyis kha thags/ sku gcig ther ma gsum bub/ dkar yol/ gon ma gcig kha'u pa spyis dar kha gsum/
